prove.mnemonic: 用证据来证明(prove)他是清白的。
prove.example: Can you prove that you were at home last night?
prove.translation: 你能证明昨晚你在家吗？

hang.mnemonic: 把衣服挂(hang)在钩上，悬着；也指诀窍。
hang.example: Please hang your coat on the hook.
hang.translation: 请把你的外套挂在钩子上。

entire.mnemonic: 整个(entire)蛋糕全吃光，一点不剩。
entire.example: She ate the entire cake by herself.
entire.translation: 她一个人吃掉了整个蛋糕。

rock.example: He picked up a rock and threw it.
rock.translation: 他捡起一块石头扔了出去。

forget.mnemonic: 忘记(forget)带钥匙，只好等门口。
forget.example: Don't forget to lock the door.

claim.mnemonic: 声称(claim)钱包是自己的，要求认领。
claim.example: He claimed that he saw the accident.
claim.translation: 他声称他看到了那场事故。

remove.mnemonic: 把污渍除去(remove)，也指搬家搬走。
remove.example: Please remove your shoes before entering.

manager.example: The manager approved our vacation request.
manager.translation: 经理批准了我们的休假申请。

enjoy.example: I really enjoy reading books on rainy days.
enjoy.translation: 我真的很喜欢在雨天读书。

network.example: The company has a large computer network.
network.translation: 这家公司有一个大型计算机网络。

legal.mnemonic: 合法的(legal)行为，受法律保护。
legal.example: It is legal to park here.

religious.mnemonic: 虔诚的(religious)信徒按时参加宗教仪式。
religious.example: She is very religious and goes to church daily.
religious.translation: 她非常虔诚，每天都去教堂。

final.mnemonic: 期末考是最后的决赛，一锤定音。
final.example: The final exam will decide our final grade.
final.translation: 期末考试将决定我们的最终成绩。

main.mnemonic: 主路是城市的主要干线。
main.example: This is the main road through the city.
main.translation: 这是穿过城市的主干道。

science.mnemonic: 科学课做实验，探索自然规律。
science.example: Science helps us understand the natural world.
science.translation: 科学帮助我们理解自然世界。

green.mnemonic: 青涩的苹果是绿色的，喻未成熟。
green.example: The green apple is not ripe yet.

memory.mnemonic: 电脑内存帮我们记住数据；人的记忆也是。
memory.example: My computer has enough memory to run this program.
memory.translation: 我的电脑有足够的内存运行这个程序。

card.example: She sent me a birthday card.
card.translation: 她给我寄了一张生日贺卡。

above.mnemonic: 抬头看，鸟在头顶上方飞。
above.example: The bird is flying above the trees.

seat.mnemonic: 请对号入座，找到自己的座位。
seat.example: Please take your seat before the show starts.

cell.mnemonic: 细胞是生命的基本单元，电池也是电的单元。
cell.example: The cell is the basic unit of life.
cell.translation: 细胞是生命的基本单元。

establish.mnemonic: 建立新公司，确立规章制度。
establish.example: They plan to establish a new company.
establish.translation: 他们计划建立一家新公司。

nice.mnemonic: 遇到和蔼的人，心情真美好。
nice.example: She is very nice to everyone.

trial.mnemonic: 新药试验像一场审判，考验效果。
trial.example: The trial will test the new drug.
trial.translation: 这次试验将测试这种新药。

expert.mnemonic: 像医院里会诊的资深医生，一看检查单就判断病因。
expert.example: She is an expert in computer science.

spring.mnemonic: 春天泉水边，弹簧一蹦跳起来。
spring.example: In spring, the children spring over the puddles.

firm.mnemonic: 这家公司立场坚定，像坚固的石头。
firm.example: She works for a law firm in London.
firm.translation: 她在伦敦一家律师事务所工作。

democrat.mnemonic: 投票站里举牌支持民主的人。
democrat.example: He is a Democrat and voted for the party.
democrat.translation: 他是民主党人，投了该党的票。

radio.mnemonic: 打开收音机，收听无线电广播。
radio.example: I listen to the radio every morning.

visit.example: We will visit our grandparents this weekend.
visit.translation: 这个周末我们将去看望祖父母。

management.mnemonic: 经理在会议室里安排经营管理工作。
management.example: The management approved the new plan.

avoid.mnemonic: 看到水坑就绕开，避免弄湿鞋。
avoid.example: You should avoid eating too much sugar.

imagine.mnemonic: 闭上眼睛，在脑海中描绘未来画面。
imagine.example: Imagine you are lying on a warm beach.
imagine.translation: 想象你正躺在温暖的海滩上。

tonight.mnemonic: 今晚月亮出来，我们去看电影。

huge.mnemonic: 大象站在眼前，像一堵巨大的墙。
huge.example: They live in a huge house by the sea.
huge.translation: 他们住在海边一栋巨大的房子里。

ball.mnemonic: 穿礼服去舞会，手里还拿着一个小球。
ball.example: The children are playing with a red ball.
ball.translation: 孩子们正在玩一个红色的球。

yourself.mnemonic: 对着镜子说：'你自己'最棒！
yourself.example: You should believe in yourself and keep going.
yourself.translation: 你应该相信自己，继续前进。

finish.mnemonic: 跑完马拉松，冲过终点线就是finish。
finish.example: She worked hard to finish the project on time.
finish.translation: 她努力工作，按时完成了项目。

theory.mnemonic: 爱因斯坦的相对论是著名的theory。
theory.example: His theory explains how the universe works.
theory.translation: 他的理论解释了宇宙如何运作。

impact.mnemonic: 陨石撞地球，巨大impact留下大坑。
impact.example: The new policy had a big impact on small businesses.
impact.translation: 新政策对小企业产生了巨大影响。

respond.mnemonic: 别人喊你名字，你转身respond：'在！'
respond.example: Please respond to my email by tomorrow.
respond.translation: 请在明天之前回复我的邮件。

statement.mnemonic: 警察让你做statement：陈述案发经过。
statement.example: The company issued a statement about the accident.
statement.translation: 公司就事故发表了一份声明。

maintain.mnemonic: 定期保养汽车，maintain良好车况。
maintain.example: It is important to maintain a healthy diet.

charge.example: They will charge you extra for the service.
charge.translation: 他们会就这项服务向你额外收费。

popular.mnemonic: 这首歌太popular，大街小巷都在放。
popular.example: This song is very popular among young people.
popular.translation: 这首歌在年轻人中非常流行。

traditional.example: She wore a traditional dress to the wedding.
traditional.translation: 她穿了一件传统服装去参加婚礼。

onto.example: He climbed onto the roof to fix the antenna.

reveal.mnemonic: 魔术师揭开布，reveal一只白鸽。
reveal.example: The survey reveals that most people are happy.
reveal.translation: 调查显示大多数人是幸福的。

direction.mnemonic: 想象在十字路口看指路牌，箭头指明方向。
direction.example: The teacher gave us clear direction on the project.
direction.translation: 老师就这个项目给了我们明确的指导。

germany.mnemonic: 德国以汽车和啤酒闻名，地图上标着Germany。
germany.example: My uncle lives in Germany and works for a car company.
germany.translation: 我叔叔住在德国，在一家汽车公司工作。

weapon.mnemonic: 警察拔出武器，喊着“放下武器”。
weapon.example: The police found a weapon hidden in the car.
weapon.translation: 警察在车里发现了一件隐藏的武器。

employee.mnemonic: 员工每天打卡上班，受雇于公司。
employee.example: Every employee must wear a name badge at work.
employee.translation: 每位员工上班时都必须佩戴姓名牌。

contain.mnemonic: 这个盒子能容纳十本书，也指控制情绪。
contain.example: This box can contain up to ten books.
contain.translation: 这个盒子最多能容纳十本书。

cultural.mnemonic: 文化差异像不同颜色的拼图，拼在一起才完整。
cultural.example: We studied cultural differences between the two countries.
cultural.translation: 我们研究了两国之间的文化差异。

peace.mnemonic: 战争结束后，人们渴望和平与安宁。
peace.example: After years of war, the country finally found peace.
peace.translation: 经过多年战争，这个国家终于迎来了和平。

pain.mnemonic: 脚趾踢到桌角，那种钻心的疼痛。
pain.example: She felt a sharp pain in her knee while running.
pain.translation: 她跑步时感到膝盖一阵剧痛。

apply.mnemonic: 申请工作要填表，涂药膏也是apply。
apply.example: You should apply for the job before Friday.
apply.translation: 你应该在周五之前申请这份工作。

october.mnemonic: 十月国庆，秋天落叶，October是第十个月。
october.example: We plan to visit Beijing in October.
october.translation: 我们计划十月份去北京。

wide.mnemonic: 站在宽广的草原上，视野特别开阔。
wide.example: The river is too wide to swim across.
wide.translation: 这条河太宽了，游不过去。

measure.mnemonic: 用尺子测量桌子尺寸，也指采取措施。
measure.example: Please measure the length of the table.
measure.translation: 请测量一下桌子的长度。

shake.mnemonic: 握手时上下摇动，或地震时杯子震动，都是shake。
shake.example: She gave the bottle a good shake before opening it.
shake.translation: 她打开瓶子前把它好好摇了一摇。

fly.mnemonic: 苍蝇叫fly，它飞得很快，也能说坐飞机fly。
fly.example: The fly flew away when I tried to swat it.
fly.translation: 我想拍那只苍蝇时，它飞走了。

interview.mnemonic: 面试时，面试官和我面对面交谈，就是interview。
interview.example: I have a job interview tomorrow morning at nine.
interview.translation: 我明天早上九点有一个求职面试。

manage.mnemonic: 经理manage公司，要处理各种事务，控制局面。
manage.example: She manages a team of ten engineers.
manage.translation: 她管理着一个十名工程师的团队。

chair.mnemonic: 主席坐在椅子上，主持会议，这把椅子就是chair。
chair.example: He was elected chair of the committee.

fish.mnemonic: 在河边fish，钓到一条fish，晚餐吃fish。
fish.example: We caught three fish in the river yesterday.
fish.translation: 我们昨天在河里抓到了三条鱼。

particular.mnemonic: 挑水果时，她只挑最特别的那一个，很particular。
particular.example: She is very particular about her coffee.

camera.mnemonic: 旅行时用camera拍照，记录风景，就是照相机。
camera.example: Don't forget to bring your camera to the party.
camera.translation: 别忘了带你的相机去派对。

structure.mnemonic: 盖房子先搭structure，像钢筋骨架。
structure.example: The engineer examined the structure of the bridge.
structure.translation: 工程师检查了这座桥的结构。

politics.mnemonic: 电视里政客辩论、拉票，就是politics。
politics.example: She decided to study politics at university.
politics.translation: 她决定在大学学习政治学。

bit.mnemonic: 咬了一口，剩下一点点；bit是bite过去式，也是少量。
bit.example: She took a bit of cake and left the rest.
bit.translation: 她吃了一小口蛋糕，剩下的留下了。

perform.mnemonic: 演员在舞台上perform，医生手术也是perform。
perform.example: The band will perform tonight at the stadium.
perform.translation: 乐队今晚将在体育场演出。

weight.mnemonic: 称体重时，秤上数字就是重量，也代表分量。
weight.example: He lifted the heavy weight with one hand.
weight.translation: 他用一只手举起了那个重物。

suddenly.mnemonic: 好好的天突然下起大雨，让人措手不及。

discover.mnemonic: 在旧书里发现一张藏宝图，就是discover。
discover.example: Scientists discover a new planet every year.
discover.translation: 科学家每年都会发现新行星。

candidate.mnemonic: 竞选台上，候选人正在慷慨激昂地演讲。
candidate.example: She is a candidate for the school president.
candidate.translation: 她是学校主席的候选人。

production.mnemonic: 工厂流水线上，汽车的生产正在日夜不停。
production.example: The production of steel increased last year.

treat.mnemonic: 朋友生日，我请客吃大餐，这就是treat。
treat.example: I will treat you to dinner tonight.

evening.mnemonic: 太阳落山后，傍晚的微风吹着很舒服。
evening.example: We take a walk every evening.

trip.mnemonic: 走路不看路，被石头绊倒，就是trip。
trip.example: He tripped over the wire and fell.
trip.translation: 他被电线绊倒摔了一跤。

affect.mnemonic: 坏天气影响心情，让人感到低落。
affect.example: The weather can affect your mood.

inside.mnemonic: 外面下雨，我躲在屋子里面，就是inside。

september.mnemonic: 九月开学季，秋高气爽，就是September。

conference.mnemonic: 很多人在会议室里讨论问题，开大会。
conference.example: She attended an international conference in Paris.
conference.translation: 她在巴黎参加了一个国际会议。

unit.mnemonic: 军训时一个班就是一个 unit，整齐又统一。
unit.example: The army unit moved quietly through the dark forest.
unit.translation: 这支部队在黑暗的森林中悄悄移动。

style.mnemonic: 她的穿搭风格很 style，走到哪里都时尚。
style.example: Her writing style is clear and easy to understand.
style.translation: 她的写作风格清晰易懂。

adult.mnemonic: 成年人 adult 要为自己的人生负责，不能再像小孩。
adult.example: Every adult must take responsibility for their own actions.
adult.translation: 每个成年人都必须为自己的行为负责。

worry.mnemonic: 别 worry 了，担心太多只会让自己更烦恼。
worry.example: Do not worry, everything will be fine in the end.
worry.translation: 别担心，最后一切都会好起来的。

mention.mnemonic: 他随口 mention 了一下，提到明天要开会。
mention.example: She did not mention the meeting to anyone.
mention.translation: 她没有向任何人提到那次会议。

range.mnemonic: 这座山脉 range 绵延百里，范围一眼望不到边。
range.example: The price range is from ten to fifty dollars.
range.translation: 价格范围从十美元到五十美元不等。

america.mnemonic: America 既是美国，也指整个美洲大陆。
america.example: He moved to America when he was twenty years old.
america.translation: 他二十岁时搬到了美国。

deep.mnemonic: 湖水很 deep，深处黑得看不见底。
deep.example: The lake is too deep for the children to swim in.
deep.translation: 这湖太深，孩子们不能在里面游泳。

edge.mnemonic: 站在悬崖 edge 边缘，再往前一步就很危险。
edge.example: She sat on the edge of the bed and cried.

specific.mnemonic: 请给出 specific 具体明确的地址，别只说大概。
specific.example: Can you give me a specific example of the problem?
specific.translation: 你能给我一个这个问题的具体例子吗？

writer.mnemonic: 这位 writer 每天写作，立志成为著名作家。
writer.example: The writer spent ten years working on this novel.
writer.translation: 这位作家花了十年写这部小说。

trouble.mnemonic: 车半路出 trouble 故障，真是麻烦又让人烦恼。
trouble.example: He got into trouble for being late again.
trouble.translation: 他因为又迟到而惹上了麻烦。

necessary.mnemonic: 出门前检查钥匙是必要的
necessary.example: It is necessary to drink water every day.

throughout.mnemonic: 他自始至终都保持沉默
throughout.example: The museum is famous throughout the world.
throughout.translation: 这家博物馆闻名全世界。

challenge.mnemonic: 面对挑战，他选择迎难而上
challenge.example: Learning a new language is a big challenge.
challenge.translation: 学习一门新语言是个巨大的挑战。

january.example: January is the first month of the year.
january.translation: 一月是一年中的第一个月。

fear.mnemonic: 黑暗里她感到一阵恐惧
fear.example: She has a fear of heights.

shoulder.example: He carried the heavy box on his shoulder.
shoulder.translation: 他把沉重的箱子扛在肩上。

institution.example: The university is a respected institution.
institution.translation: 这所大学是一所受人尊敬的机构。

middle.example: The cat sat in the middle of the road.

sunday.example: We often go hiking on Sunday.
sunday.translation: 我们经常在星期日去远足。

dream.example: I had a strange dream last night.
dream.translation: 我昨晚做了个奇怪的梦。

bar.mnemonic: 酒吧门前的木条挡住了路
bar.example: They met at a bar after work.
bar.translation: 他们下班后在酒吧见面。

beautiful.example: She looked beautiful in that dress.

property.mnemonic: property 是财产，也指性质、属性。
property.example: She inherited the property from her aunt.
property.translation: 她从姑妈那里继承了这份财产。

instead.mnemonic: 没去派对，instead 在家看书。
instead.example: I didn't eat pizza; I had salad instead.
instead.translation: 我没吃披萨，反而吃了沙拉。

goods.mnemonic: good 加 s，变成货物、商品。
goods.example: The goods are in the warehouse.

improve.mnemonic: 每天练习，improve 英语水平。
improve.example: I want to improve my writing skills.
improve.translation: 我想提高我的写作技能。

stuff.mnemonic: stuff 就是东西，也能装填、狼吞虎咽。
stuff.example: Put your stuff in the locker.
stuff.translation: 把你的东西放进储物柜。

detail.example: She explained the plan in detail.

somebody.mnemonic: somebody 是某人，也是大人物。

magazine.mnemonic: magazine 是杂志，也是弹匣、仓库。
magazine.example: She bought a magazine at the store.
magazine.translation: 她在商店买了一本杂志。

reflect.mnemonic: 照镜子时，镜面反射出你的样子，你看着它深思。
reflect.example: The mirror reflects her face clearly.
reflect.translation: 镜子清晰地映出她的脸。

heavy.mnemonic: 搬重箱子，累得喘不过气，脚步沉重。
heavy.example: This box is too heavy to lift.

sexual.mnemonic: 青春期对异性产生性方面的好奇。
sexual.example: Sexual health education is important for teenagers.
sexual.translation: 性健康教育对青少年很重要。

bag.mnemonic: 购物时把东西装进袋子，袋子鼓起来。
bag.example: She put the groceries in a paper bag.
bag.translation: 她把食品杂货放进纸袋。

heat.mnemonic: 夏天太阳的热让地面发烫，加热食物。
heat.example: Heat the soup for five minutes.

york.mnemonic: 英国有个约克郡，约克王朝曾统治。
york.example: York is a historic city in England.
york.translation: 约克是英格兰的一座历史城市。

marriage.mnemonic: 两人戴上戒指，承诺共度一生，组成婚姻。
marriage.example: Their marriage has lasted for thirty years.
marriage.translation: 他们的婚姻已经持续了三十年。

tough.mnemonic: 硬汉走过艰苦的路，咬紧牙关不放弃。
tough.example: It was a tough decision to make.

sing.mnemonic: 鸟儿在枝头唱歌，人们也开口唱。
sing.example: She loves to sing in the shower.

purpose.mnemonic: 做事前先问目的，有目的才有方向。
purpose.example: What is the purpose of your visit?
purpose.translation: 你此次访问的目的是什么？

surface.mnemonic: 看水面表面平静，鱼却在水下，浮出水面。
surface.example: The submarine surfaced near the coast.
surface.translation: 潜艇在海岸附近浮出水面。

exist.mnemonic: 我思故我在，思考证明自己存在。

pattern.mnemonic: 毛衣上的花图案(pattern),我照它画格子,这就是模式。
pattern.example: The dress has a beautiful floral pattern.
pattern.translation: 这条裙子有漂亮的花卉图案。

realise.mnemonic: 直到签下合同,他才realise梦想终于实现。
realise.example: I didn't realise how late it was.
realise.translation: 我没意识到已经这么晚了。

whom.mnemonic: 你把这封信给谁(whom)?给谁就用whom。
whom.example: Whom did you give the book to?

skin.mnemonic: 晒伤后皮肤(skin)发红,像被剥了皮一样疼。

agent.mnemonic: 房产agent带你看房,像中介媒介帮你成交。
agent.example: Our agent found us a nice house.
agent.translation: 我们的代理商给我们找了栋好房子。

owner.mnemonic: 狗牌上写着owner电话,丢了就能找物主。
owner.example: The owner of the car is my uncle.
owner.translation: 这辆车的车主是我叔叔。

machine.mnemonic: 洗衣machine轰隆隆转,像机械般工作的人。

gas.mnemonic: 车没gas了,去加气站;气球里装的是气体。
gas.example: We need to stop for gas.

ahead.mnemonic: 赛跑时跑ahead,领先一步,提前到达终点。
ahead.example: She ran ahead to open the door.

generation.mnemonic: 爷爷奶奶、爸妈、我,三代人(generation)像发电产生。
generation.translation: 这一代人喜欢智能手机。

commercial.mnemonic: 电视commercial一响,就是商业推销时间。
commercial.example: The commercial break lasts two minutes.

address.mnemonic: 信封写address,总统发表演说也用它,要对付问题。
address.translation: 请在这里写下你的地址。

cancer.mnemonic: 体检报告上出现‘癌’字，全家陷入沉默

item.mnemonic: 购物清单上一条条打勾：每项(item)都不能漏
item.example: Please check each item on the list.
item.translation: 请核对清单上的每一项。

reality.mnemonic: 梦想撞上现实，才知什么是事实
reality.example: The reality is harder than we imagined.
reality.translation: 现实比我们想象的更艰难。

coach.mnemonic: 教练(coach)像赶四轮马车一样督促训练
coach.example: The coach trains the team every morning.
coach.translation: 教练每天早上训练队伍。

means.mnemonic: 为了达到目的，可以不择手段(means)
means.translation: 为达目的可以不择手段。

yard.mnemonic: 院子里量出一码(yard)长的木料
yard.example: The children are playing in the yard.

beat.mnemonic: 心跳的节拍(beat)像鼓点，一拳打败对手
beat.example: His heart beat fast after the race.
beat.translation: 比赛后他的心跳得很快。

violence.example: The violence in the film shocked her.
violence.translation: 电影中的暴力场面让她震惊。

total.mnemonic: 把账单所有项目加总(total)得总数
total.example: The total cost was higher than expected.

tend.mnemonic: 人容易(tend)偏向熟悉的路，也照顾花园
tend.example: People tend to forget details over time.
tend.translation: 人们往往会随着时间忘记细节。

investment.example: She made a wise investment in stocks.
investment.translation: 她在股票上做了明智的投资。

ireland.mnemonic: 绿宝石岛爱尔兰(Ireland)，风笛与黑啤
ireland.example: Ireland is famous for its green landscapes.
ireland.translation: 爱尔兰以其绿色风景闻名。

discussion.mnemonic: 开会时大家围坐，你一言我一语，就是讨论。
discussion.example: We had a long discussion about the project.
discussion.translation: 我们对该项目进行了长时间的讨论。

finger.mnemonic: 手指伸进手套，每个指头都有专属小房间。
finger.example: She pointed at the map with her finger.

garden.mnemonic: 周末在花园里种花拔草，享受阳光。
garden.example: We grow tomatoes and roses in our garden.
garden.translation: 我们在花园里种西红柿和玫瑰。

notice.mnemonic: 墙上贴着一张布告，路过的人都会注意到。
notice.example: Please notice the sign on the door.

collection.mnemonic: 爷爷的书房里摆满了他一生的收藏品。
collection.example: His stamp collection is worth a lot of money.
collection.translation: 他的邮票收藏价值不菲。

modern.mnemonic: 现代人用智能手机，住高楼，穿时髦衣服。
modern.example: Modern technology has changed our daily lives.
modern.translation: 现代科技改变了我们的日常生活。

task.mnemonic: 老板派给我一个任务，今天必须完成。
task.example: I have to finish this task before noon.
task.translation: 我必须在中午之前完成这项任务。

partner.mnemonic: 创业时找一个靠谱的合伙人，一起打拼。
partner.example: She is my business partner and best friend.
partner.translation: 她是我的生意伙伴兼最好的朋友。

positive.mnemonic: 保持积极心态，凡事往好处想，结果就会更好。
positive.example: He has a positive attitude towards life.
positive.translation: 他对生活持有积极的态度。

civil.mnemonic: 公民要遵守法律，对人也要有礼貌。
civil.example: The civil rights movement changed history.

kitchen.mnemonic: 妈妈在厨房里忙碌，锅碗瓢盆摆满灶台。
kitchen.example: She is cooking dinner in the kitchen.

consumer.mnemonic: 消费者在超市挑选商品，比较价格和质量。
consumer.example: Consumers have the right to return defective products.
consumer.translation: 消费者有权退回有缺陷的产品。

shot.mnemonic: 一声枪响，shot 就是那一发射击；篮球一投也叫 shot。
shot.example: The hunter fired a shot at the deer.

budget.mnemonic: 月初做预算，budget 就是管钱计划；买廉价货也要算进去。
budget.example: We need to budget carefully for the trip.
budget.translation: 我们需要为旅行仔细做预算。

wish.mnemonic: 生日吹蜡烛，许个 wish，就是希望愿望成真。
wish.example: I wish you a happy birthday.

painting.mnemonic: 美术馆墙上挂的 painting，是画也是油漆活。
painting.example: She bought a beautiful painting for the living room.
painting.translation: 她为客厅买了一幅漂亮的画。

scientist.mnemonic: 实验室里穿白大褂的 scientist，就是科学家。
scientist.example: The scientist discovered a new vaccine.
scientist.translation: 这位科学家发现了一种新疫苗。

safe.mnemonic: 把钱锁进 safe 保险箱，感觉又安全又可靠。
safe.example: Keep your passport in the hotel safe.
safe.translation: 把护照放在酒店保险箱里。

agreement.mnemonic: 双方点头签下 agreement，就是达成协议和同意。
agreement.example: They finally reached an agreement after long talks.
agreement.translation: 经过长时间谈判，他们终于达成了协议。

november.mnemonic: 十一月 November，秋末冬初，感恩节就在这个月。

december.mnemonic: 十二月 December，年末圣诞和跨年都在这个月。
december.example: December is the last month of the year.
december.translation: 十二月是一年的最后一个月。

mouth.mnemonic: mouth 就是嘴巴，用来吃饭说话；张口做鬼脸。

capital.mnemonic: capital 一词三用：首都、大写字母、资本。
capital.example: Beijing is the capital of China.

nor.mnemonic: nor 是也不，常和 neither 连用，表示两者都不。

victim.mnemonic: 车祸现场，受伤者被抬走，他就是victim。
victim.example: The victim reported the theft to the police immediately.
victim.translation: 受害者立即向警方报告了盗窃案。

newspaper.mnemonic: 早餐桌上摊开newspaper，边喝咖啡边看新闻。
newspaper.example: She reads the newspaper every morning at breakfast.

threat.mnemonic: 收到匿名信写着“小心”，这是threat。
threat.example: The dark clouds are a threat of heavy rain.

responsibility.mnemonic: 项目出问题，负责人站出来说“这是我的responsibility”。
responsibility.example: Taking care of the child is his responsibility.
responsibility.translation: 照顾这个孩子是他的责任。

smile.mnemonic: 拍照时摄影师喊“笑一个”，你露出smile。
smile.example: She gave me a warm smile at the door.
smile.translation: 她在门口给了我一个温暖的微笑。

attorney.mnemonic: 法庭上，attorney替当事人辩护，争取权益。
attorney.example: The attorney advised him not to answer that question.
attorney.translation: 律师建议他不要回答那个问题。

score.mnemonic: 比赛最后一秒投中，score变成100比99。
score.example: The final score was three to two.

account.mnemonic: 银行开account，记下每笔收支，也能解释来龙去脉。
account.example: Please check your bank account for the missing payment.
account.translation: 请检查你的银行账户是否有那笔缺失的付款。

interesting.mnemonic: 这本书情节反转不断，读起来非常interesting。
interesting.example: I found the history lesson surprisingly interesting today.
interesting.translation: 我觉得今天的历史课意外地有趣。

audience.mnemonic: 演讲者一开口，audience立刻安静下来聆听。
audience.example: The audience clapped loudly after the performance ended.
audience.translation: 演出结束后，观众热烈鼓掌。

rich.mnemonic: 他靠石油致富，住大宅开名车，非常rich。
rich.example: This region is rich in oil and natural gas.
rich.translation: 这个地区富含石油和天然气。

dinner.mnemonic: 晚上七点，全家围坐餐桌吃dinner。
dinner.example: We invited them to dinner on Friday evening.
dinner.translation: 我们邀请他们周五晚上来吃晚餐。

recognise.mnemonic: 在人群中认出熟人，也承认自己错了。
recognise.example: I didn't recognise you with your new haircut.
recognise.translation: 你换了新发型，我没认出你。

vote.example: I will vote for the new policy.

western.mnemonic: 西部片里的牛仔来自西方。
western.example: He loves watching old western movies.

relate.mnemonic: 把两件事关联起来叙述，相处融洽。
relate.example: These two events relate to each other.

travel.example: We travel to new places every summer.
travel.translation: 我们每年夏天去新地方旅行。

debate.example: They debate the issue for hours.
debate.translation: 他们为此事辩论了几个小时。

prevent.translation: 疫苗预防许多严重疾病。

citizen.mnemonic: 城市里的市民，就是公民。
citizen.example: Every citizen has the right to vote.

majority.example: The majority of students passed the exam.
majority.translation: 大多数学生通过了考试。

none.example: None of the answers are correct.
none.translation: 没有一个答案是正确的。

front.example: The soldier stood at the front line.

admit.mnemonic: 门口保安点头放你进，也算承认你够格。
admit.example: She admitted that she had made a serious mistake.
admit.translation: 她承认自己犯了一个严重错误。

senior.mnemonic: 公司里白发前辈，年龄大、资历深，坐前排。
senior.example: My senior colleague helped me learn the new system.
senior.translation: 我的资深同事帮我学习新系统。

assume.mnemonic: 没证据就先假定；把任务承担下来，也装出样子。
assume.example: We assume the train will arrive on time.
assume.translation: 我们假定火车会准时到达。

wind.mnemonic: 风吹弯小路蜿蜒；给钟上发条要一圈圈缠绕。
wind.example: A cold wind made us close the windows.
wind.translation: 一阵冷风让我们关上了窗户。

key.mnemonic: 钥匙开锁是关键；钢琴按键定基调，也是答案线索。
key.example: This key opens the door to the secret room.
key.translation: 这把钥匙能打开密室的门。

professional.mnemonic: 穿正装、凭专业本事吃饭的人。
professional.example: She hired a professional to fix the leaking roof.
professional.translation: 她雇了一位专业人员来修漏雨的屋顶。

mission.mnemonic: 带着使命出发，完成任务；传教团也远行。
mission.example: Their mission was to rescue the trapped miners.
mission.translation: 他们的任务是营救被困矿工。

fast.mnemonic: 跑得飞快；绳子绑得紧；为了信仰绝食斋戒。
fast.example: He can run fast, but he cannot fast for long.
fast.translation: 他跑得快，但不能长时间禁食。

alone.mnemonic: 一个人待着，独自孤单，没有别人。
alone.example: She lives alone but never feels lonely.
alone.translation: 她独自居住，却从不感到孤独。

customer.mnemonic: 进店掏钱买东西的顾客，就是消费者。
customer.example: The customer asked for a refund on the broken item.
customer.translation: 顾客要求对损坏的商品退款。

suffer.mnemonic: 生病受伤都要忍受痛苦，遭受折磨。
suffer.example: Many people suffer from hunger and disease.
suffer.translation: 许多人遭受饥饿和疾病之苦。

speech.mnemonic: 站在台上发表演讲，说话言语也成篇章。
speech.example: His speech moved everyone in the audience.
speech.translation: 他的演讲感动了在场每一位观众。

successful.mnemonic: 一路顺利，事事成功，就是成功的状态。
successful.example: She became a successful doctor after years of hard work.
successful.translation: 经过多年努力，她成了一名成功的医生。

option.mnemonic: 面前摆着几个选项，任你挑选一个。
option.example: You have the option to change your plan.

participant.mnemonic: 报名参加活动的人，就是参与者。
participant.example: Every participant received a name tag at the door.
participant.translation: 每位参与者在门口都领到了姓名牌。

southern.mnemonic: 住在南边的人，说话带南方口音。
southern.example: They moved to a southern city near the coast.
southern.translation: 他们搬到了海岸附近的一座南方城市。

eventually.mnemonic: 过程漫长，最后终于到达终点。
eventually.example: He eventually finished the marathon after many months.
eventually.translation: 几个月后，他终于跑完了马拉松。

university.mnemonic: 高中毕业进大学，追求更高学问。
university.example: She studies computer science at a famous university.
university.translation: 她在一所著名大学学习计算机科学。

fresh.mnemonic: 刚摘的菜很新鲜，人也要精神饱满。
fresh.example: I bought fresh vegetables from the local market.
fresh.translation: 我从当地市场买了新鲜蔬菜。

forest.mnemonic: 大片树木聚成林，动物藏在森林里。
forest.example: We walked through the quiet forest at sunrise.
forest.translation: 日出时我们穿过安静的森林。

video.mnemonic: 用手机拍下动态影像，就是视频。
video.example: She watched a short video about space travel.
video.translation: 她看了一段关于太空旅行的短视频。

global.mnemonic: 绕地球一圈，影响遍及全球。
global.example: Climate change is a global problem for everyone.
global.translation: 气候变化是每个人面临的全球问题。

senate.mnemonic: 参议院里议员们开会，讨论并制定法律。
senate.example: The senate passed the new law after a long debate.
senate.translation: 参议院经过长时间辩论通过了新法律。

reform.mnemonic: 旧制度要改，重新塑造便是改革。
reform.example: The government promised to reform the tax system.
reform.translation: 政府承诺改革税收制度。

access.mnemonic: 想进大楼得刷卡——access就是入口和进入权。
access.example: Students need access to the library after hours.
access.translation: 学生需要在课后使用图书馆。

restaurant.example: We had dinner at a new restaurant downtown.
restaurant.translation: 我们在市中心一家新餐馆吃了晚饭。

judge.mnemonic: 法庭上敲锤的法官，比赛里吹哨的裁判，都叫judge。
judge.example: The judge listened carefully to both sides.
judge.translation: 法官仔细听取了双方陈述。

publish.mnemonic: 把书稿交给出版社，让大众“公开”看到——publish。
publish.example: They will publish his new novel next month.
publish.translation: 他们下个月将出版他的新小说。

relation.mnemonic: 家人亲戚是relation，人和人的联系也是relation。
relation.example: The relation between the two events is unclear.
relation.translation: 这两个事件之间的关系尚不清楚。

release.mnemonic: 把笼中鸟放走，把新版本发布——都是release。
release.example: The prisoner was released after ten years.

bird.mnemonic: 天上飞的鸟，场上打的羽毛球，都叫bird。
bird.example: A small bird landed on the windowsill.

labor.mnemonic: 劳工(labor)在工厂里辛苦劳动，母亲分娩也labor。
labor.example: The workers labored all day in the hot sun.
labor.translation: 工人们在烈日下辛苦劳作了一整天。

opinion.mnemonic: 每个人都有自己的opinion，即对事的意见和评价。
opinion.example: In my opinion, the plan needs more work.
opinion.translation: 在我看来，这个计划还需要完善。

credit.mnemonic: 信用卡靠信用，修课攒学分，功劳归credit。
credit.example: She deserves credit for the project's success.
credit.translation: 这个项目的成功应归功于她。

critical.mnemonic: 病情到了临界点，医生说是critical；批评也是critical。
critical.example: The next few days are critical for his recovery.
critical.translation: 接下来几天对他的康复至关重要。

corner.mnemonic: 把对手逼到墙角(corner)，让他陷入窘境。
corner.example: He sat in the corner reading a book.

concerned.mnemonic: 母亲皱眉追问“你还好吗”，满是关心
concerned.example: She is concerned about her son's health.

recall.mnemonic: 闭上眼努力回想童年，就像大脑在调用存档
recall.example: I can't recall his name right now.
recall.translation: 我现在想不起他的名字。

version.mnemonic: 同一部电影，导演剪辑版和影院版，你说哪个版本？
version.example: This is the latest version of the software.
version.translation: 这是该软件的最新版本。

stare.mnemonic: 他盯着屏幕发呆，眼睛一眨不眨
stare.example: Don't stare at strangers; it's impolite.
stare.translation: 别盯着陌生人看，那样不礼貌。

safety.mnemonic: 上车先系安全带，安全第一

effective.mnemonic: 这药真有效，一吃就不疼了
effective.example: This medicine is very effective against headaches.
effective.translation: 这种药治头痛非常有效。

neighborhood.mnemonic: 小区附近的公园，邻居们常去散步
neighborhood.example: There is a park in my neighborhood.

original.mnemonic: 这是原版画作，复印的没法比
original.example: This is the original painting, not a copy.

troop.mnemonic: 一队士兵整齐地走过广场
troop.example: A troop of soldiers marched through the square.
troop.translation: 一队士兵齐步走过广场。

income.mnemonic: 每月工资到账，这是主要收入
income.example: His monthly income covers the rent.

hurt.mnemonic: 摔了一跤，膝盖好疼，心里也难受
hurt.example: His words hurt her feelings deeply.
hurt.translation: 他的话深深伤害了她的感情。

species.mnemonic: 生物分类中，同一‘种’外形相似：猫和虎不同species。
species.example: There are many species of birds in this forest.
species.translation: 这片森林里有许多种鸟。

immediately.mnemonic: 老板说“立刻”，你马上放下手头事去执行。
immediately.example: He left immediately after receiving the phone call.
immediately.translation: 他接到电话后立刻离开了。

track.mnemonic: 猎人沿着地上的足迹(track)追踪猎物。
track.example: The police tracked the thief through the dark alley.
track.translation: 警察穿过黑暗的小巷追踪小偷。

basic.mnemonic: 盖房先打地基，这是最基本(basic)的步骤。
basic.example: Food and water are basic needs for survival.
basic.translation: 食物和水是生存的基本需求。

strike.mnemonic: 工人罢工(strike)时，用拳头打击(strike)罢工破坏者。
strike.example: The workers decided to strike for higher pay.
strike.translation: 工人们决定罢工要求提高工资。

sky.mnemonic: 抬头看天空(sky)，蓝天白云，像天堂一样。
sky.example: The sky turned pink and orange at sunset.
sky.translation: 日落时天空变成了粉橙色。

freedom.mnemonic: 小鸟飞出笼子，重获自由(freedom)。
freedom.example: They fought for freedom and equality for all.
freedom.translation: 他们为所有人的自由和平等而战。

absolutely.mnemonic: 你绝对(absolutely)不能把这件事说出去。
absolutely.example: I absolutely agree with your plan.

plane.mnemonic: 木匠用刨子(plane)把木板刨平，像飞机(plane)一样滑过。
plane.example: The plane landed smoothly on the runway.
plane.translation: 飞机平稳地降落在跑道上。

nobody.mnemonic: 聚会上没人(nobody)理他，他成了无名小卒。
nobody.example: Nobody knows the answer to this question.
nobody.translation: 没有人知道这个问题的答案。

achieve.mnemonic: 运动员努力训练，终于达到(achieve)目标。
achieve.example: She worked hard to achieve her dream.
achieve.translation: 她努力工作以实现梦想。

object.mnemonic: 他反对(object)这个计划，因为目标(object)不明确。
object.example: I object to this unfair decision.
object.translation: 我反对这个不公平的决定。

nine.mnemonic: 数到九就停，猫有九条命。
nine.example: There are nine players on a baseball team.

attitude.mnemonic: 面试时坐直，态度藏在姿势里。
attitude.example: Her positive attitude helped the team win the game.
attitude.translation: 她积极的态度帮助球队赢下比赛。

refer.mnemonic: 写论文要提到并查阅参考文献。
refer.example: Please refer to page ten for more details.

client.mnemonic: 律师见客户，电脑连客户机。
client.example: The lawyer met a new client this morning.
client.translation: 律师今天早上见了一位新客户。

concept.mnemonic: 老师拿苹果讲‘水果’这个概念。
concept.example: The concept of time is hard to explain.

powerful.mnemonic: 大力士一拳推倒墙，真强大。
powerful.example: This car has a powerful engine.

saturday.mnemonic: 周六睡懒觉，不用设闹钟。
saturday.example: We will visit the museum on Saturday.
saturday.translation: 我们星期六将参观博物馆。

perfect.mnemonic: 排练到完美，完成时表示已做完。
perfect.example: Practice makes perfect, so keep trying.
perfect.translation: 熟能生巧，所以继续尝试。

therefore.example: It was raining; therefore, we stayed inside.
therefore.translation: 当时在下雨，因此我们待在室内。

conduct.mnemonic: 指挥乐队，也指人的行为；铜线导电。
conduct.example: She will conduct the orchestra tonight.
conduct.translation: 她今晚将指挥管弦乐队。

announce.mnemonic: 校长广播宣布明天放假。
announce.example: They will announce the winner tomorrow.
announce.translation: 他们明天将宣布获胜者。

conversation.mnemonic: 咖啡馆里两人聊得很投入。
conversation.example: We had a long conversation about our future.
conversation.translation: 我们就未来进行了长谈。

examine.example: The doctor will examine you carefully.

touch.mnemonic: 手指轻触(touch)琴键，触觉与感动。

please.mnemonic: 请(please)让我取悦你，使你高兴。

attend.mnemonic: 参加(attend)会议要专心照料细节。
attend.example: I will attend the meeting tomorrow.

completely.mnemonic: 完全(complete)地(ly)完成，就是完全地。
completely.example: She was completely surprised by the news.
completely.translation: 她对这个消息感到完全惊讶。

variety.example: The store offers a variety of fruits.
variety.translation: 这家商店提供多种水果。

sleep.example: I need to sleep for eight hours.

involved.mnemonic: 卷入(involve)复杂局面，难以脱身。
involved.example: The plot is too involved to follow.

investigation.example: The police started an investigation into the theft.
investigation.translation: 警方开始调查这起盗窃案。

nuclear.example: They discussed nuclear energy at the meeting.
nuclear.translation: 他们在会上讨论了核能。

researcher.mnemonic: 反复搜索(search)的人，就是研究员。
researcher.example: The researcher found a new virus.
researcher.translation: 这位研究人员发现了一种新病毒。

press.example: Press the button to start the machine.

conflict.mnemonic: 两人为方案争得面红耳赤，这就是 conflict。
conflict.example: The conflict between the two countries lasted for years.
conflict.translation: 两国之间的冲突持续了多年。

spirit.mnemonic: 烈酒 spirit 下肚，精神一振。
spirit.example: She has a strong spirit and never gives up.

states.mnemonic: United States 的简称，指美国。
states.example: He moved to the States last year.

replace.mnemonic: 旧电池没电，用新电池 replace。
replace.example: Please replace the broken window with a new one.
replace.translation: 请用新窗户替换破掉的那扇。

british.mnemonic: 英国人 British 爱喝下午茶。
british.example: The British weather is often rainy.

encourage.mnemonic: 老师 encourage 学生：再试一次！
encourage.example: My parents always encourage me to try new things.
encourage.translation: 我父母总是鼓励我尝试新事物。

argument.mnemonic: 为数据争得面红耳赤，一场 argument。
argument.example: They had a heated argument about politics.
argument.translation: 他们因政治发生激烈争论。

camp.mnemonic: 周末去山里 camp，搭起帐篷看星星。
camp.example: We set up camp near the river.

february.mnemonic: 二月 February，春节往往在这月。

brain.mnemonic: 大脑 brain 是思考的器官。
brain.example: The human brain is very complex.

feature.mnemonic: 五官是容貌 feature，也是特色。
feature.example: Her eyes are her best feature.
feature.translation: 她的眼睛是她最好看的特征。

afternoon.mnemonic: 午后 afternoon，喝杯咖啡休息一下。
afternoon.example: We will meet this afternoon at three.
afternoon.translation: 我们今天下午三点见面。

am.mnemonic: I am 中的 am；大写 AM 指上午，也指调幅。
am.example: I am ready for the AM meeting.
am.translation: 我已准备好参加上午的会议。

weekend.mnemonic: 周末：一周忙碌后的休息日，常睡懒觉或出游。
weekend.example: We plan to relax at home this weekend.
weekend.translation: 这个周末我们打算在家放松。

dozen.mnemonic: 一打鸡蛋十二个，买一打送半打。
dozen.example: She bought a dozen eggs at the market.
dozen.translation: 她在市场买了一打鸡蛋。

possibility.mnemonic: 可能发生的事：门开着，就有溜出去的可能。
possibility.example: There is a possibility of rain tomorrow.

insurance.mnemonic: 买保险，出事能赔；保险业靠保费运转。
insurance.example: He bought insurance for his new car.

department.mnemonic: 公司部门、大学系：各管一摊。
department.example: She works in the sales department.

battle.mnemonic: 两军对阵，打一场大 battle；也可指奋斗。
battle.example: The soldiers fought a fierce battle.
battle.translation: 士兵们打了一场激烈的战役。

beginning.mnemonic: 万事开头难，beginning 就是最初那一步。
beginning.example: This is just the beginning of our journey.
beginning.translation: 这只是我们旅程的开始。

date.mnemonic: Date 三义：日期、约会、枣椰树；约会先定日期。
date.example: What is the date of your appointment?

generally.mnemonic: generally 通常：一般情况都这样。
generally.example: Generally, I wake up early on weekdays.
generally.translation: 通常，我在工作日醒得早。

african.mnemonic: 非洲的、非洲人：Africa 加 n 构成。
african.example: She is an African student from Kenya.
african.translation: 她是一位来自肯尼亚的非洲学生。

sorry.mnemonic: 心里难过或抱歉，就说 I am sorry。
sorry.example: I am sorry for being late.

crisis.mnemonic: 公司濒临倒闭，老板拍桌：这是生死关头！危机时刻。
crisis.example: The country is facing a serious economic crisis.
crisis.translation: 这个国家正面临严重的经济危机。

complete.mnemonic: 拼图最后一块放上去，整幅图完成了，变得完全的。
complete.example: She completed the project on time.
complete.translation: 她按时完成了这个项目。

fan.mnemonic: 夏天开风扇，足球迷挥旗子，都是fan。
fan.example: He is a big fan of football.

stick.mnemonic: 捡根棍子，把纸粘在门上，stick既是棍也是粘。
stick.example: Please stick the label on the box.

define.mnemonic: 老师用一句话把苹果说清楚，这就是定义。
define.example: Can you define this word for me?
define.translation: 你能给我定义一下这个词吗？

easily.mnemonic: 他轻松地举起箱子，还流利地说着英语。

hole.mnemonic: 袜子破了个洞，脚趾头钻出来，这就是hole。
hole.example: There is a hole in my sock.

element.mnemonic: 做菜要放盐，盐是味道的基本要素；元素周期表也是element。
element.example: Trust is an important element of friendship.
element.translation: 信任是友谊的重要要素。

status.mnemonic: 手机屏幕显示充电中，这就是当前状态。
status.example: What is the status of the project?

vision.mnemonic: 他视力极好，能看到远处的山；也有远见。

normal.mnemonic: 体温36.5度是正常，大家觉得这是常态。

chinese.mnemonic: 中国人说中文，用筷子吃饺子。

ship.mnemonic: 大轮'ship'在海上，装货运人两不误。
ship.example: The ship will ship goods to Europe next week.
ship.translation: 这艘船下周将把货物运往欧洲。

stone.mnemonic: 一块'stone'可铺路，可当宝石，还能投掷。
stone.example: They used a stone to stone the birds away.
stone.translation: 他们用一块石头扔向鸟群把它们赶走。

solution.mnemonic: 问题'solution'是解答，化学'solution'是溶液。
solution.example: We found a solution to the problem and mixed a solution.
solution.translation: 我们找到了问题的解决方法，并混合了一种溶液。

slowly.example: Please speak slowly so I can understand you.
slowly.translation: 请说慢一点，这样我能听懂你。

scale.mnemonic: 鱼有'scale'鳞，秤有'scale'刻度，山要'scale'攀登。
scale.example: The fish scales can be weighed on a scale.
scale.translation: 鱼的鳞片可以在秤上称重。

introduce.mnemonic: 新人见面要'introduce'介绍，新方法要'introduce'引入。
introduce.example: Let me introduce my friend and introduce a new method.
introduce.translation: 让我介绍我的朋友，并引入一种新方法。

driver.mnemonic: 司机'driver'开车，电脑'driver'驱动硬件。
driver.example: The driver installed a new driver for the printer.
driver.translation: 司机为打印机安装了一个新驱动程序。

attempt.mnemonic: 一次'attempt'尝试，不成功再试一次。
attempt.example: He made an attempt to climb the mountain.
attempt.translation: 他做了一次攀登这座山的尝试。

spot.mnemonic: 衣服上有个'spot'斑点，当场'spot'认出地点。
spot.example: I spotted a spot on the spot of the crime.
spot.translation: 我在犯罪现场发现了一个斑点。

lack.mnemonic: 缺乏'lack'就是没有，缺水缺钱都叫lack。
lack.example: The plants lack water because of the lack of rain.
lack.translation: 由于缺乏雨水，植物缺水。

ice.mnemonic: 水结'ice'冰，蛋糕上'ice'糖衣，冰镇饮料。
ice.example: Please ice the cake and put ice in the drink.
ice.translation: 请给蛋糕覆上糖衣，并在饮料里加冰。

boat.example: We will boat across the lake in a small boat.
boat.translation: 我们将乘一艘小船划过湖面。

christmas.mnemonic: 十二月二十五日，红袜礼物圣诞树，全家团聚。
christmas.example: We open presents on Christmas morning with the whole family.
christmas.translation: 我们在圣诞节早上和全家人一起拆礼物。

drink.mnemonic: 口渴端起杯子，一口喝下；也可指饮料或酒。
drink.example: Let's drink some water before we continue the hike.
drink.translation: 我们继续徒步前喝点水吧。

sun.mnemonic: 抬头看见天上大火球，晒被晒衣都靠它。
sun.example: The sun is shining brightly today, so wear a hat.
sun.translation: 今天太阳很晒，戴顶帽子吧。

distance.mnemonic: 两点之间有多远，开车看里程，远方叫 distance。
distance.example: The distance between the two cities is about 200 kilometers.
distance.translation: 两座城市之间的距离大约200公里。

wood.mnemonic: 森林砍下的木头，做桌子椅子，也指树林。
wood.example: The table is made of solid wood from oak trees.
wood.translation: 这张桌子是用橡树的实木做的。

truck.mnemonic: 路上大货车，载货跑长途；也可指交易或实物工资。
truck.example: He drives a truck to deliver goods across the country.
truck.translation: 他开卡车在全国各地送货。

handle.mnemonic: 门把手一拉就开，处理事情也叫 handle。
handle.example: She turned the handle and opened the door quietly.
handle.translation: 她转动把手，轻轻打开了门。

mountain.mnemonic: 又高又大的山，爬山累，山顶风景好。
mountain.example: They climbed the mountain and saw the sunrise.
mountain.translation: 他们爬上山，看到了日出。

survey.mnemonic: 从高处俯瞰全景，或发问卷做调查。
survey.example: The survey shows most people prefer working from home.
survey.translation: 调查显示大多数人喜欢在家工作。

tradition.mnemonic: 一代传一代的老规矩，过节吃饺子就是 tradition。
tradition.example: It's a family tradition to eat dumplings on New Year's Eve.
tradition.translation: 除夕吃饺子是家庭传统。

winter.mnemonic: 一年最冷的季节，下雪穿棉袄，动物冬眠。
winter.example: In winter, we often stay inside and drink hot tea.
winter.translation: 冬天我们常待在屋里喝热茶。

village.mnemonic: 山脚下小村子，几户人家，鸡犬相闻。
village.example: He grew up in a small village near the river.
village.translation: 他在河边一个小村庄长大。

soviet.mnemonic: 联想“苏维埃”音译，一个代表会议。
soviet.example: The Soviet Union launched the first satellite.
soviet.translation: 苏联发射了第一颗人造卫星。

refuse.mnemonic: 两个意思：拒绝请求，或堆在门口的废物。
refuse.example: She refused to answer the question.

sales.mnemonic: 销售部门业绩，用 sales 表示。
sales.example: The sales team exceeded their monthly target.
sales.translation: 销售团队超额完成了月度目标。

roll.mnemonic: 一卷纸在地上滚动，也指名单。
roll.example: The ball rolled down the hill.

africa.mnemonic: 非洲大陆，阳光炙热，野生动物成群。
africa.example: Africa is the second largest continent.

communication.mnemonic: 交流通讯，信息传递的桥梁。
communication.example: Good communication is key to teamwork.
communication.translation: 良好的沟通是团队合作的关键。

screen.mnemonic: 屏幕放映电影，也可筛沙子。
screen.example: The movie was shown on a large screen.

gain.mnemonic: 获得利润，增益，或体重增加。
gain.example: He gained a lot of experience from the job.
gain.translation: 他从这份工作中获得了很多经验。

resident.mnemonic: 居民住在当地，常驻程序也 resident。
resident.example: She is a resident of this small town.

hide.example: He tried to hide his disappointment.
hide.translation: 他试图掩饰自己的失望。

gold.mnemonic: 黄金宝贵，金色闪耀，钱财。
gold.example: The ring is made of pure gold.
gold.translation: 这枚戒指是纯金制成的。

club.mnemonic: 俱乐部里，用木棍打球，联合起来。
club.example: They joined a local tennis club.
club.translation: 他们加入了当地的网球俱乐部。

farm.mnemonic: 农民在农田里耕种，太阳晒得直冒汗。
farm.example: My uncle works on a farm every day.
farm.translation: 我叔叔每天在农场干活。

potential.mnemonic: 他潜力巨大，只差一个机会爆发出来。
potential.example: She has great potential to become a top scientist.
potential.translation: 她很有潜力成为顶尖科学家。

european.mnemonic: 欧洲人爱喝咖啡，坐在广场上晒太阳。
european.example: The European tourist took photos of the old castle.
european.translation: 那位欧洲游客拍了老城堡的照片。

presence.mnemonic: 他出席晚宴，一进门就引人注目，风度不凡。
presence.example: Your presence at the meeting is very important.
presence.translation: 你出席这次会议非常重要。

independent.mnemonic: 他独立自主，不依赖父母，自己租房生活。
independent.example: She became independent after moving to another city.
independent.translation: 她搬到另一个城市后变得独立了。

district.mnemonic: 城市这个区域商店多，是热闹的商业地段。
district.example: They live in a quiet district near the river.
district.translation: 他们住在河边一个安静的区域。

shape.mnemonic: 用模具把黏土塑成圆形，形状就定了。
shape.example: The cloud changed shape as the wind blew.

reader.mnemonic: 读者捧着读物，坐在灯下读到深夜。
reader.example: The reader turned the page slowly.

contract.mnemonic: 签了合约就得遵守，别想随便反悔。
contract.example: They signed a contract to buy the house.

crowd.mnemonic: 人群挤满广场，一伙人挤进地铁。
crowd.example: A large crowd gathered outside the stadium.
crowd.translation: 一大群人聚集在体育场外。

christian.mnemonic: 基督徒每周去教堂，祈祷与唱诗。
christian.example: He is a devout Christian who attends church.
christian.translation: 他是个虔诚的基督徒，常去教堂。

express.mnemonic: 他明确表达想法，还坐快车去送快递。
express.example: I cannot express how grateful I am to you.
express.translation: 我无法表达对你有多感激。

apartment.mnemonic: 一个门牌号里，客厅卧室厨房都在一起，这就是公寓。
apartment.example: I live in a small apartment near the park.
apartment.translation: 我住在公园附近的一间小公寓里。

willing.mnemonic: 心里愿意，举手说“我来！”——乐意的。
willing.example: She is willing to help us with the project.
willing.translation: 她乐意帮我们做这个项目。

strength.mnemonic: 健身房举铁，练的就是力量；咖啡的浓度也叫强度。
strength.example: He used all his strength to lift the box.
strength.translation: 他用尽全身力气举起那个箱子。

previous.mnemonic: 上一页、上一集、上一位——都是“早先的”。
previous.example: Please check the previous page for more details.
previous.translation: 请查看前一页了解更多细节。

band.mnemonic: 一根橡皮筋把大家绑成乐队，也是“带子”。
band.example: The band played all night at the party.
band.translation: 乐队在派对上演奏了一整晚。

obviously.mnemonic: 事情摆在眼前，一眼就看出，显然如此。
obviously.example: Obviously, he didn't read the instructions carefully.
obviously.translation: 显然，他没有仔细阅读说明。

horse.mnemonic: 草原上骑马飞奔，四条腿的动物就是马。
horse.example: The horse ran fast across the open field.
horse.translation: 那匹马飞快地跑过开阔的田野。

target.mnemonic: 射箭瞄准靶心，那个红心就是目标。
target.example: Our target is to finish the work by Friday.
target.translation: 我们的目标是在周五前完成工作。

prison.mnemonic: 铁窗、高墙，失去自由的地方就是监狱。
prison.example: He was sent to prison for five years.

ride.mnemonic: 骑上自行车、马或车，一段路程就是乘坐。
ride.example: I ride my bike to school every day.

guard.mnemonic: 门口站岗的人，眼睛紧盯，就是守卫。
guard.example: The guard stood at the gate all night.

terms.mnemonic: 合同里一条一条写清楚的条件和费用，就是条款。
terms.example: We agreed on the terms of the contract.
terms.translation: 我们就合同条款达成了一致。

reporter.mnemonic: 采访现场，记者举着话筒追问“报道这事的人”。
reporter.example: The reporter asked the mayor about the new policy.
reporter.translation: 记者就新政策向市长提问。

demand.mnemonic: 客户拍桌提要求：这批货必须明天到。
demand.example: The workers demand better pay and safer conditions.
demand.translation: 工人们要求更好的待遇和更安全的条件。

deliver.mnemonic: 快递员按门铃，把包裹亲手递到你手里。
deliver.example: She will deliver the package to your office tomorrow.
deliver.translation: 她明天会把包裹送到你办公室。

text.mnemonic: 手机一震，你低头读那条短短的文字消息。
text.example: Please send me the text of the agreement.

tool.mnemonic: 修车师傅从工具箱里拿出扳手，开始拧螺丝。
tool.example: A hammer is a useful tool for building a house.
tool.translation: 锤子是盖房子时有用的工具。

wild.mnemonic: 荒野里一只野狼盯着你，风把草丛吹得乱晃。
wild.example: We saw wild horses running across the open plain.
wild.translation: 我们看到野马在开阔的平原上奔跑。

vehicle.mnemonic: 清晨，一辆公交车作为交通工具载着人们驶向市区。
vehicle.example: The vehicle stopped suddenly at the red light.
vehicle.translation: 那辆车在红灯前突然停下。

observe.mnemonic: 科学家在望远镜后仔细观察星星的移动。
observe.example: Scientists observe the stars through a powerful telescope.
observe.translation: 科学家通过强大的望远镜观察星星。

flight.mnemonic: 候机厅广播响起，你的航班开始登机。
flight.example: Our flight to Tokyo leaves at six in the morning.
flight.translation: 我们飞往东京的航班早上六点起飞。

facility.mnemonic: 新建的体育馆设施齐全，运动员们训练很方便。
facility.example: The new sports facility includes a pool and a gym.
facility.translation: 新的体育设施包括一个游泳池和健身房。

understanding.mnemonic: 两人争吵后坐下来谈心，终于达成相互理解。
understanding.example: We reached an understanding after a long conversation.
understanding.translation: 经过长谈，我们达成了谅解。

average.mnemonic: 把全班分数加起来除以人数，得到平均分。
average.example: The average temperature in July is about thirty degrees.
average.translation: 七月的平均温度约为三十度。

emerge.mnemonic: 水落石出，真相从水面浮出
emerge.example: The sun emerged from behind the clouds.

advantage.example: Having a car is a great advantage.
advantage.translation: 有辆车是个很大的优势。

leadership.mnemonic: 领导像掌舵，带团队前行
leadership.example: Good leadership is essential for success.
leadership.translation: 良好的领导能力对成功至关重要。

earn.translation: 他挣得一份不错的薪水。

basis.mnemonic: 基础是根本，也是主要成分
basis.example: Trust is the basis of friendship.

operate.mnemonic: 操作机器像做手术一样精准

guest.example: We have a special guest today.
guest.translation: 今天我们有一位特别的客人。

sample.mnemonic: 先尝样品，再决定买不买
sample.example: She took a sample of the cake.

contribute.mnemonic: 贡献一份力，投稿又捐助
contribute.example: Everyone can contribute to the project.
contribute.translation: 每个人都能为这个项目做贡献。

tiny.mnemonic: 想象一只小蚂蚁，tiny 就是它那么小。
tiny.example: A tiny ant crawled across the table.
tiny.translation: 一只微小的蚂蚁爬过桌子。

block.example: They live on the next block.

protection.mnemonic: 戴头盔是对头部的保护(protection)。
protection.example: Wear a helmet for protection while riding.
protection.translation: 骑车时戴头盔以作保护。

settle.mnemonic: 旅行后定居(settle)下来，把一切安排(settle)妥当。
settle.example: They decided to settle in a small town.
settle.translation: 他们决定在一个小镇定居。

feed.mnemonic: 用饲料(feed)喂(feed)小动物，或给打印机送纸(feed)。
feed.example: Please feed the dog before you leave.

collect.example: I collect stamps from different countries.
collect.translation: 我收集来自不同国家的邮票。

additional.mnemonic: 在原有基础上加(add)更多，就是额外的(additional)。
additional.example: We need additional time to finish the project.
additional.translation: 我们需要额外的时间来完成这个项目。

highly.mnemonic: 高(high)到极点，就是非常(highly)赞许。
highly.example: She is highly respected by her colleagues.

identity.mnemonic: 证明你是你，就是身份(identity)证明。
identity.example: Please show your identity card at the gate.
identity.translation: 请在门口出示你的身份证。

title.example: What is the title of that book?

mostly.mnemonic: 大部分(most)加上-ly，表示主要地(mostly)。
mostly.example: The students are mostly from China.
mostly.translation: 这些学生大部分来自中国。

lesson.example: We learned a valuable lesson today.
lesson.translation: 我们今天学到了宝贵的一课。

faith.mnemonic: 对某人交托真心，就是信心。
faith.example: I have great faith in your ability.
faith.translation: 我对你的能力很有信心。

river.example: The river flows to the sea.

promote.mnemonic: 向上推一把，就是晋升和促进。
promote.example: The company promoted him to manager.

living.example: She earns a living by teaching.

count.mnemonic: 伯爵也在一笔一笔数钱。
count.example: Please count the books on the shelf.

unless.example: I won't go unless you come with me.
unless.translation: 除非你和我一起去，否则我不去。

marry.mnemonic: 两人牵手走进婚姻殿堂。
marry.example: They plan to marry next spring.
marry.translation: 他们计划明年春天结婚。

tomorrow.example: Tomorrow will be a better day.

technique.example: She learned a new painting technique.
technique.translation: 她学会了一种新的绘画技巧。

path.example: Follow this path to the village.
path.translation: 沿着这条小路走到村庄。

shop.mnemonic: 到商店购物，也在车间干活。
shop.example: I need to shop for groceries today.
shop.translation: 我今天需要去买食品杂货。

folk.mnemonic: 乡村民谣里唱的人们、家人，就是folk。
folk.example: The old folk in the village still tell these stories.
folk.translation: 村里的老人们仍然讲述这些故事。

principle.example: He refused to lie because it went against his principles.
principle.translation: 他拒绝撒谎，因为这违背他的原则。

survive.mnemonic: 幸存者(survivor)从灾难中活下来，survive。
survive.example: Only a few plants can survive in the desert.
survive.translation: 只有少数植物能在沙漠中生存。

lift.mnemonic: 电梯(lift)把人和物举起、升高。
lift.example: Take the lift to the fifth floor.

border.mnemonic: 边界(border)像花坛边缘，镶在两国之间。
border.example: The river forms the border between the two countries.
border.translation: 这条河形成两国之间的边界。

competition.mnemonic: 大家一起来(com)竞争(competition)，争取第一。
competition.example: There is fierce competition for the job.
competition.translation: 这份工作的竞争很激烈。

jump.mnemonic: 跳(jump)一下，价格暴涨，心跳惊跳。
jump.example: The cat made a sudden jump onto the table.

gather.mnemonic: 像“gether”一起，人们聚集(gather)收集东西。
gather.example: We gather together to celebrate the festival.
gather.translation: 我们聚在一起庆祝节日。

limit.mnemonic: 极限(limit)就是不能再超越的界限。
limit.example: Speed limit is 60 kilometers per hour here.

fit.mnemonic: 衣服合身(fit)说明尺寸适宜、安装合适。

cry.mnemonic: 哭(cry)就是大声哭喊、叫出声。
cry.example: The baby began to cry loudly.

equipment.example: The lab has all the necessary equipment.
equipment.translation: 实验室有所有必要的设备。

worth.mnemonic: 这枚旧硬币值多少钱？它的价值在于回忆。
worth.example: This old coin is worth a lot to me.
worth.translation: 这枚旧硬币对我来说很值钱。

associate.mnemonic: 把同事联想成一起喝咖啡的伙伴
associate.example: I associate this song with my childhood.
associate.translation: 我把这首歌和我的童年联系在一起。

critic.mnemonic: 影评人看完电影后写严厉批评
critic.example: The critic praised the new film.
critic.translation: 那位批评家赞扬了这部新电影。

warm.mnemonic: 冬天把手放在暖气旁取暖
warm.example: She gave me a warm smile.
warm.translation: 她给了我一个温暖的微笑。

aspect.mnemonic: 看问题要从多个方面看
aspect.example: We must consider every aspect of the plan.
aspect.translation: 我们必须考虑这个计划的每个方面。

insist.example: She will insist on paying for dinner.

failure.mnemonic: 考试不及格是一种失败
failure.example: His failure to appear surprised everyone.
failure.translation: 他未能出现让大家很惊讶。

annual.mnemonic: 公司每年发布年度报告
annual.example: The company holds an annual meeting in May.
annual.translation: 公司在五月举行年度会议。

french.mnemonic: 法国人说法语，爱吃法式面包
french.example: She is learning French at school.

comment.mnemonic: 在文章下写评论发表看法
comment.example: He made a rude comment about her hair.
comment.translation: 他对她的头发发表了粗鲁的评论。

affair.mnemonic: 他卷入了一场婚外恋事件
affair.example: The party was a boring affair.
affair.translation: 那个派对是件无聊的事。

responsible.mnemonic: 父母要对孩子的安全负责
responsible.example: She is responsible for the whole project.

procedure.mnemonic: 看病流程：挂号、就诊、取药，这就是procedure。
procedure.example: The doctor explained the procedure before the surgery.
procedure.translation: 医生在手术前解释了程序。

regular.mnemonic: 每天定时跑步，像钟表一样规律——regular。
regular.example: She is a regular customer at this coffee shop.
regular.translation: 她是这家咖啡店的常客。

spread.mnemonic: 往面包上涂果酱，再铺开——spread。
spread.example: She spread the butter evenly on the toast.
spread.translation: 她把黄油均匀地涂在吐司上。

chairman.mnemonic: 会议室里坐主位、敲锤子的人就是chairman。
chairman.example: The chairman opened the meeting with a short speech.
chairman.translation: 主席以简短讲话开始了会议。

baseball.mnemonic: 戴手套、挥棒击球跑垒的运动——baseball。
baseball.example: They played baseball in the park all afternoon.
baseball.translation: 他们整个下午都在公园打棒球。

soft.mnemonic: 摸小猫的毛，又软又温柔——soft。
soft.example: The pillow is very soft and comfortable.
soft.translation: 这个枕头非常柔软舒适。

ignore.mnemonic: 手机响个不停，你假装没听见——ignore。
ignore.example: He ignored my advice and made a mistake.
ignore.translation: 他忽视了我的建议，犯了个错误。

egg.example: She boiled an egg for breakfast.

belief.mnemonic: 心中深信不疑的东西，就是belief。
belief.example: Her belief in justice never wavered.
belief.translation: 她对正义的信念从未动摇。

demonstrate.mnemonic: 老师做实验演示，证明给学生看——demonstrate。
demonstrate.example: The teacher will demonstrate the experiment to the class.
demonstrate.translation: 老师将向全班演示这个实验。

anybody.example: Anybody can join the club for free.
anybody.translation: 任何人都可以免费加入俱乐部。

murder.mnemonic: 侦探小说里，凶手杀人后留下线索——murder。
murder.example: The police are investigating the murder case.
murder.translation: 警方正在调查这起谋杀案。

gift.mnemonic: 生日收到礼物，也发现自己的天赋，是上天赋予。
gift.example: She gave me a gift and I thanked her.
gift.translation: 她给了我一份礼物，我感谢了她。

religion.mnemonic: 每周去教堂，心中信仰宗教。
religion.example: Religion plays an important role in many cultures.
religion.translation: 宗教在许多文化中扮演重要角色。

review.mnemonic: 考试前复习，也回顾检讨自己的错误。
review.example: I need to review my notes before the exam.
review.translation: 我需要在考试前复习笔记。

editor.mnemonic: 编辑坐在桌前，改稿写评论。
editor.example: The editor fixed many mistakes in my article.
editor.translation: 编辑修正了我文章中的许多错误。

engage.mnemonic: 答应从事新工作，忙碌投入其中。
engage.example: He decided to engage in the new project.
engage.translation: 他决定从事这个新项目。

coffee.mnemonic: 早晨一杯咖啡，提神又暖身。
coffee.example: I drink a cup of coffee every morning.
coffee.translation: 我每天早上喝一杯咖啡。

document.mnemonic: 电脑里的文件文档，可用来证明事实。
document.example: Please save the document before closing the program.
document.translation: 请在关闭程序前保存文档。

speed.mnemonic: 汽车加速超速，速度飞快。
speed.example: The car increased its speed on the highway.
speed.translation: 汽车在高速公路上加速了。

cross.mnemonic: 在十字路口，生气地横过马路。
cross.example: Look both ways before you cross the street.

influence.mnemonic: 朋友的影响力，能改变你的选择。
influence.example: Her words had a strong influence on me.

anyway.mnemonic: 下雨了，无论如何我都要去。
anyway.example: It is raining, but I will go anyway.
anyway.translation: 天在下雨，但我无论如何都要去。

commit.mnemonic: 承诺承担义务，绝不犯罪。
commit.example: She committed herself to finishing the project.

threaten.mnemonic: 黑云压城，预示暴雨将至，像在恐吓大地。
threaten.example: Dark clouds threaten a storm, so we hurry home.
threaten.translation: 乌云预示着暴风雨，我们匆忙回家。

female.mnemonic: 洗手间门上的穿裙小人标志，代表女性。
female.example: The female scientist won the prize for her research.
female.translation: 那位女科学家因她的研究获奖。

youth.mnemonic: 操场上奔跑的学生们，满是青春活力。
youth.example: In his youth, he traveled around the world alone.
youth.translation: 他年轻时独自环游世界。

wave.mnemonic: 海边白浪一波波涌来，她挥手向船告别。
wave.example: She gave a friendly wave before boarding the train.
wave.translation: 上火车前，她友好地挥了挥手。

afraid.mnemonic: 深夜听到怪声，孩子缩进被窝，害怕得不敢动。
afraid.example: I'm afraid I can't attend your party tonight.
afraid.translation: 恐怕我今晚不能参加你的聚会了。

quarter.mnemonic: 披萨切成四份，每份四分之一；三点一刻也是 quarter。
quarter.example: Each quarter of the pizza has different toppings.
quarter.translation: 披萨的每一块都有不同的配料。

background.mnemonic: 证件照后面那块蓝色布，就是背景。
background.example: The mountains in the background make the photo beautiful.
background.translation: 背景中的群山使这张照片很美。

native.mnemonic: 在故乡街头，本地人用方言热情指路。
native.example: She is a native speaker of Mandarin Chinese.

broad.mnemonic: 站在一望无际的草原上，宽广得看不到边。
broad.example: The river is broad and deep near the bridge.
broad.translation: 桥附近的河面又宽又深。

wonderful.mnemonic: 看到满天流星雨，忍不住喊：太奇妙了！
wonderful.example: We had a wonderful time at the beach yesterday.
wonderful.translation: 昨天我们在海滩玩得非常开心。

deny.mnemonic: 监控拍得清清楚楚，他仍摇头否认偷窃。
deny.example: He denied taking the money from the drawer.
deny.translation: 他否认从抽屉里拿了钱。

slightly.mnemonic: 汤只稍微咸了一点，再加点水就行。
slightly.example: The soup is slightly too salty for my taste.
slightly.translation: 这汤对我来说稍微有点咸。

reaction.mnemonic: 手碰热锅立刻缩回——re(再)加action(动作)，就是身体的"反应"
reaction.example: Her reaction to the news was complete silence.
reaction.translation: 她对这个消息的反应是完全沉默。

twice.mnemonic: 一周去健身房两次，效果是别人的两倍：two 变 twice
twice.example: I go swimming twice a week.

suit.mnemonic: 穿一套(suit)西装去面试，正好适合(suit)这份工作
suit.example: This dark suit really suits you.
suit.translation: 这套深色西装真适合你。

perspective.mnemonic: 站在山顶看城市，视角不同，风景也全然不同
perspective.example: Try to see the problem from her perspective.
perspective.translation: 试着从她的视角看这个问题。

blow.mnemonic: 生日吹(blow)蜡烛，一口气；挨一拳也是 blow(打击)
blow.example: Blow out the candles and make a wish.

construction.mnemonic: 戴安全帽进工地，看楼一层层建起来——建筑、施工
construction.example: The new bridge is still under construction.

intelligence.mnemonic: 人工智能(AI)靠智力，战场上靠情报，同一个词
intelligence.example: He has great intelligence but little patience.
intelligence.translation: 他智力很高，但没什么耐心。

destroy.mnemonic: 地震把整座城市毁成废墟——彻底 destroy(破坏)
destroy.example: The fire destroyed the whole building.

cook.mnemonic: 厨房里那位厨师，既能当名词也能动词——做饭
cook.example: My father cooks dinner every evening.
cook.translation: 我父亲每天傍晚做晚饭。

connection.mnemonic: 网线两头一插，连接(connection)通了，人和人的关系也通了
connection.example: There is a strong connection between diet and health.
connection.translation: 饮食与健康之间有密切关系。

burn.mnemonic: 手碰到炉子会烧(burn)伤，留下一块烙印
burn.example: Be careful not to burn the toast.

shoe.mnemonic: 出门先穿鞋(shoe)，马的"鞋"是蹄铁，车的"鞋"是外胎
shoe.example: These shoes are too small for me.
shoe.translation: 这双鞋对我来说太小了。

neighbor.mnemonic: 隔壁住的人，见面点头微笑，就是邻居。
neighbor.example: My neighbor often helps me water the plants when I travel.
neighbor.translation: 我旅行时，邻居经常帮我给植物浇水。

grade.mnemonic: 爬坡分等级，年级成绩都靠它。
grade.example: She got a good grade on her math exam.
grade.translation: 她数学考试得了好成绩。

context.mnemonic: 看词看上下文，背景来龙去脉全清楚。
context.example: You can guess the meaning from the context.
context.translation: 你可以从上下文猜出意思。

committee.mnemonic: 大家围坐一起，商量事情，组成委员会。
committee.example: The committee will meet tomorrow to discuss the plan.
committee.translation: 委员会明天开会讨论这个计划。

hey.mnemonic: 打招呼喊一声“嗨”，hey 就是嗨。
hey.example: Hey, look at that beautiful bird!

mistake.mnemonic: 拿错东西，误会一场，都是 mistake。
mistake.example: I made a mistake in my calculations.
mistake.translation: 我在计算中犯了一个错误。

location.mnemonic: 找地点看位置，特定区域叫 location。
location.example: The location of the new store is very convenient.

clothes.mnemonic: 每天穿的衣服，就是 clothes。
clothes.example: She washed her clothes and hung them outside.

quiet.mnemonic: 图书馆里很安静，保持 quiet。
quiet.example: Please be quiet during the exam.

indian.mnemonic: 印度人或印第安人，都是 Indian。
indian.example: My Indian friend taught me how to cook curry.
indian.translation: 我的印度朋友教我做咖喱。

dress.mnemonic: 穿衣打扮，一条连衣裙也叫 dress。
dress.example: She wore a beautiful red dress to the party.
dress.translation: 她穿了一条漂亮的红色连衣裙去参加聚会。

promise.mnemonic: 答应别人的事，就是许下 promise。
promise.example: He promised to help me with my homework.

aware.mnemonic: 早上醒来睁开眼，就知道天亮了——清醒知道身边事。
aware.example: She was not aware of the danger ahead.
aware.translation: 她没有意识到前方的危险。

function.mnemonic: 手机能打电话拍照，这就是它的功能；心脏跳动是官能。
function.example: The heart's main function is to pump blood.
function.translation: 心脏的主要功能是泵血。

bone.mnemonic: 狗叼着骨头，专心致志地啃，谁叫都不理。
bone.example: The dog buried a bone in the garden.
bone.translation: 狗在花园里埋了一根骨头。

active.mnemonic: 操场上跑跳的学生很活跃，像上了发条。
active.example: She is very active in community service.

extend.mnemonic: 手伸长去够高处的苹果，范围向外延伸。
extend.example: They plan to extend the road to the next town.
extend.translation: 他们计划把路延伸到下一个镇。

chief.mnemonic: 部落酋长站在最前面，他是主要领袖。
chief.example: The chief ordered his men to retreat.

combine.mnemonic: 面粉加水结合成面团，联合收割机把收割和脱粒结合。
combine.example: Combine the flour and water to make dough.
combine.translation: 把面粉和水混合做成面团。

wine.mnemonic: 晚餐时倒一杯暗红色葡萄酒，慢慢品尝。
wine.example: They drank red wine with dinner.
wine.translation: 他们晚餐时喝了红葡萄酒。

below.mnemonic: 温度计的水银柱降到零度以下，就在下面。
below.example: Please write your name below the line.
below.translation: 请把名字写在横线下面。

cool.mnemonic: 夏天进空调房，凉爽的空气让人冷静下来。
cool.example: The evening air was cool and refreshing.

voter.mnemonic: 选举日，选民排队把票投进票箱。
voter.example: Every voter must show an ID at the poll.
voter.translation: 每个选民在投票站都必须出示身份证。

bus.mnemonic: 公共汽车沿固定线路跑；电脑里数据也走总线。
bus.example: I take the bus to work every morning.
bus.translation: 我每天早上乘公共汽车上班。

learning.mnemonic: 学习就是不断积累，活到老学到老。
learning.example: Learning a new language takes time and practice.
learning.translation: 学习一门新语言需要时间和练习。

hell.mnemonic: 地狱是无尽的煎熬，如同身处火海。
hell.example: The battlefield was a living hell for the soldiers.
hell.translation: 战场对士兵们来说就是人间地狱。

dangerous.mnemonic: 危险区域挂警示牌，千万别靠近。
dangerous.example: Driving in the storm is very dangerous.
dangerous.translation: 在暴风雨中开车非常危险。

remind.mnemonic: 手机闹钟准时提醒你该起床了。
remind.example: Please remind me to call my mother tonight.
remind.translation: 请提醒我今晚给妈妈打电话。

moral.mnemonic: 寓言结尾常点明一个道德寓意。
moral.example: The story has a clear moral about honesty.
moral.translation: 这个故事有一个关于诚实的明确寓意。

united.mnemonic: 球队团结一致，才能赢得比赛。
united.example: The united team worked together to win the championship.
united.translation: 团结的团队齐心协力赢得了冠军。

category.mnemonic: 超市按种类把商品摆在不同货架。
category.example: This book belongs to the history category.

relatively.mnemonic: 相对而言，今天比昨天暖和多了。
relatively.example: The exam was relatively easy compared to the last one.
relatively.translation: 与上次相比，这次考试相对容易。

victory.mnemonic: 冲过终点线那一刻，胜利属于你。
victory.example: The team celebrated their victory with a big party.
victory.translation: 球队举办盛大派对庆祝胜利。

theatre.mnemonic: 剧院灯光暗下，演出即将开始。
theatre.example: We watched a Shakespeare play at the theatre last night.
theatre.translation: 昨晚我们在剧院看了一场莎士比亚戏剧。

academic.mnemonic: 大学教师埋头做学术研究。
academic.example: Her academic achievements earned her a scholarship.
academic.translation: 她的学术成就为她赢得了奖学金。

internet.mnemonic: 互联网把全世界的人连在一起。
internet.example: I found the answer on the internet.
internet.translation: 我在互联网上找到了答案。

healthy.mnemonic: 吃健康食品，每天锻炼，身体棒。
healthy.example: Eating vegetables and exercising daily keeps you healthy.
healthy.translation: 每天吃蔬菜和锻炼能让你保持健康。

negative.mnemonic: 拍照底片是负的，态度消极也是负的。
negative.example: His negative attitude affected the whole team.
negative.translation: 他消极的态度影响了整个团队。

following.mnemonic: 领导身后跟着一群追随者，下列事项请照办。
following.example: Please read the following instructions carefully before starting.
following.translation: 开始前请仔细阅读以下说明。

japan.example: Japan is known for its traditional lacquerware.
japan.translation: 日本以其传统漆器闻名。

historical.mnemonic: 历史博物馆里陈列着历史性的文献。
historical.example: The museum displays many historical documents.
historical.translation: 博物馆展出许多历史文献。

medicine.mnemonic: 生病吃药，学医救人，内科开药。
medicine.example: Take this medicine three times a day.

tour.mnemonic: 跟着旅行团，环游各地观光。
tour.example: We took a tour of the ancient city.

depend.mnemonic: 别总依赖别人，凡事靠自己。
depend.example: Children depend on their parents for food and shelter.
depend.translation: 孩子们依赖父母提供食物和住所。

finding.mnemonic: 调查结束后，公布发现和裁决结果。
finding.example: The committee published its findings after the investigation.
finding.translation: 委员会在调查后公布了调查结果。

grab.mnemonic: 一把抓住机会，抢到手里。
grab.example: He grabbed the last ticket before anyone else.
grab.translation: 他抢在别人之前抓住了最后一张票。

direct.mnemonic: 导演直接指挥演员，说话坦白。
direct.example: She directed the play with great passion.
direct.translation: 她满怀热情地导演了这部戏。

classroom.mnemonic: 学生在教室里上课，老师在讲台前。
classroom.example: The students are studying in the classroom.
classroom.translation: 学生们正在教室里学习。

contact.mnemonic: 打电话、发邮件，保持联系
contact.example: Please contact me if you need any help.
contact.translation: 如果你需要任何帮助，请联系我。

justice.mnemonic: 法官敲锤，主持正义与公正
justice.example: The judge fought for justice and fairness.
justice.translation: 法官为正义和公平而战。

photograph.mnemonic: 按下快门，把风景拍成照片
photograph.example: She took a photograph of the sunset.
photograph.translation: 她拍了一张日落的照片。

participate.example: Everyone can participate in the discussion.
participate.translation: 每个人都可以参与讨论。

daily.mnemonic: 每天读日报，做日常运动
daily.example: I read the daily newspaper every morning.

fair.mnemonic: 市集上买卖公平，天气晴朗
fair.example: We went to the fair on a sunny day.
fair.translation: 我们在一个晴天去了市集。

pair.mnemonic: 一双鞋、一对情侣，成双成对
pair.example: She bought a pair of new shoes.

famous.example: This city is famous for its beautiful gardens.
famous.translation: 这座城市因美丽的花园而闻名。

exercise.mnemonic: 每天做运动，完成练习作业
exercise.example: I exercise for thirty minutes every morning.
exercise.translation: 我每天早上锻炼三十分钟。

knee.mnemonic: 跑步摔到膝盖，跪下用膝盖碰
knee.example: He hurt his knee while playing football.

flower.mnemonic: 花园里的花开了，精华盛时
flower.example: A beautiful flower grows in the garden.
flower.translation: 一朵美丽的花在花园里生长。

tape.mnemonic: 用胶带绑东西，磁带录音
tape.example: Please tape the box before mailing it.
tape.translation: 寄之前请用胶带把盒子封好。

hire.mnemonic: 老板雇人要先谈租金/工资，hire既是雇也是租。
hire.example: We decided to hire a car for the weekend.
hire.translation: 我们决定周末租一辆车。

familiar.mnemonic: 常客一进门，服务员就 familiar：脸熟得像家人。
familiar.example: Her face looks familiar, but I forget her name.
familiar.translation: 她看起来很面熟，但我忘了她的名字。

appropriate.mnemonic: 开会穿 appropriate 衣服；公司还 appropriate 一笔预算。
appropriate.example: Please choose an appropriate gift for the occasion.
appropriate.translation: 请为这个场合挑一件合适的礼物。

supply.mnemonic: 前线缺粮，后勤 supply 补给；有供给才能替代短缺。
supply.example: The company supplies fresh water to the village.
supply.translation: 这家公司向村子供应淡水。

actor.mnemonic: 舞台上的 actor 是男演员，生活中也是行动者。
actor.example: The actor forgot his lines on stage.
actor.translation: 那位男演员在台上忘了台词。

birth.mnemonic: 婴儿 birth 一哭，便是生命的起源。
birth.example: She gave birth to a healthy baby girl.
birth.translation: 她生下了一个健康的女婴。

search.mnemonic: 在电脑里 search 文件，像在屋里搜寻丢失钥匙。
search.example: We searched the whole house for the missing keys.
search.translation: 我们搜遍整栋房子找丢失的钥匙。

tie.mnemonic: 领带 tie 系在脖子上；比分打平也叫 tie。
tie.example: He wore a red tie to the interview.

democracy.mnemonic: 一人一票选领导，democracy 就是民主政治。
democracy.example: Democracy allows people to vote for their leaders.
democracy.translation: 民主允许人们投票选举领导人。

eastern.mnemonic: 太阳升起的方向是 eastern，东方人住那边。
eastern.example: The eastern part of the country is mountainous.

primary.mnemonic: 小学 primary school 是最初阶段，也是最重要的基础。
primary.example: Our primary goal is to save money this year.
primary.translation: 我们今年的首要目标是省钱。

yesterday.mnemonic: 日历翻过一页，昨天的事已经过去。
yesterday.example: I saw him at the library yesterday.
yesterday.translation: 我昨天在图书馆看见他。

circle.mnemonic: 想象一群人围成圆圈跳舞，就是社交圈和圆周。
circle.example: The children sat in a circle around the teacher.
circle.translation: 孩子们围成一圈坐在老师周围。

device.mnemonic: 电子设备是巧妙设计的装置，也是一种策略。
device.example: This device helps you measure the temperature accurately.
device.translation: 这个装置能帮你准确测量温度。

progress.mnemonic: 学习如登山，每走一步都是进步。
progress.example: She made great progress in her English studies.
progress.translation: 她在英语学习上取得了很大进步。

bottom.mnemonic: 瓶底藏着秘密，要查明真相。
bottom.example: The treasure was hidden at the bottom of the sea.

island.mnemonic: 大海中的岛屿，像孤立的安全岛。
island.example: They live on a small island in the Pacific.
island.translation: 他们住在太平洋的一个小岛上。

exchange.mnemonic: 在交易所交换货币，就像打电话交换信息。
exchange.example: We exchanged gifts at the party.
exchange.translation: 我们在聚会上交换了礼物。

clean.mnemonic: 打扫房间，让它干净又清白。
clean.example: Please clean your room before dinner.
clean.translation: 请在晚饭前打扫你的房间。

studio.mnemonic: 画家在工作室画画，演员在演播室表演。
studio.example: The artist works in a small studio.
studio.translation: 这位艺术家在一间小工作室里工作。

county.mnemonic: 英国有郡，中国有县，都是地区单位。
county.example: He lives in a quiet county in England.
county.translation: 他住在英格兰一个安静的郡。

train.mnemonic: 火车一节节排列，像训练有素的队伍。
train.example: We took a train to the city.

lady.mnemonic: 一位优雅的女士就是淑女。
lady.example: The old lady smiled at the children.
lady.translation: 那位老太太对孩子们微笑。

colleague.mnemonic: 和你一起在办公室工作的同事。
colleague.example: I discussed the project with my colleague.
colleague.translation: 我和同事讨论了这个项目。

application.mnemonic: 申请应用要填志愿书，像手机装App一样。
application.example: I submitted my job application online yesterday.
application.translation: 我昨天在线提交了求职申请。

lean.mnemonic: 瘦子倚靠墙，身体倾斜，只吃瘦肉。
lean.example: He leaned against the wall and ate lean meat.

neck.mnemonic: 脖子缩进衣领，情侣拥吻脖子。
neck.example: She wore a scarf around her neck.
neck.translation: 她脖子上围着一条围巾。

damage.mnemonic: 大坝（dam）决堤，造成巨大损害。
damage.example: The storm caused severe damage to the crops.
damage.translation: 暴风雨对农作物造成了严重损害。

plastic.mnemonic: 塑料可塑，易受影响，能塑造各种造型。
plastic.example: These plastic bottles can be recycled.
plastic.translation: 这些塑料瓶可以回收利用。

tall.mnemonic: 高个子说大话，夸大其词。
tall.example: He is tall and tells tall tales.

plate.mnemonic: 盘子镀金成金属板，还能当印版。
plate.example: She put the cake on a plate.

hate.mnemonic: 我恨吃西兰花，厌恶它的味道。
hate.example: I hate getting up early on Mondays.

otherwise.mnemonic: 否则就不同了，用别的方式做。
otherwise.example: Hurry up, otherwise we will miss the train.
otherwise.translation: 快点，否则我们会错过火车。

writing.mnemonic: 书写笔迹成著作，作品要常练。
writing.example: Her writing is neat and easy to read.

male.example: The male bird has bright feathers.
male.translation: 这只雄鸟有鲜艳的羽毛。

alive.mnemonic: 活着就活泼，对热闹敏感。
alive.example: The old tree is still alive and green.
alive.translation: 那棵老树仍然活着，绿意盎然。

expression.mnemonic: 把心里的话“表达”出来；数学里叫表达式。
expression.example: Her facial expression showed she was very happy.
expression.translation: 她的面部表情显示她非常开心。

football.mnemonic: 足球和橄榄球都叫football，看语境。
football.example: The boys are playing football in the park.
football.translation: 男孩们正在公园里踢足球。

theater.mnemonic: 去theater看戏或电影，观众坐满剧场。
theater.example: We watched a play at the theater last night.
theater.translation: 昨晚我们在剧院看了一场戏。

intend.mnemonic: 心里计划“打算”做，intend to do。
intend.example: I intend to finish the work today.
intend.translation: 我打算今天完成这项工作。

chicken.mnemonic: 小鸡和鸡肉都是chicken，餐桌上常见。
chicken.example: We had fried chicken for dinner last night.
chicken.translation: 昨晚我们晚餐吃了炸鸡。

army.example: The army marched through the city.

abuse.mnemonic: 滥用权力或虐待他人，都是abuse。
abuse.example: He was punished for abusing his power.
abuse.translation: 他因滥用权力而受到惩罚。

shut.mnemonic: 把门关上，shut the door；商店关门停业。
shut.example: Please shut the door when you leave.

map.mnemonic: 看地图找路；程序里也做映射。
map.example: I looked at the map to find the station.
map.translation: 我查看地图来寻找车站。

extra.mnemonic: 额外多出来的，要另外收费。
extra.example: We paid extra for a bigger room.
extra.translation: 我们为更大的房间额外付了钱。

session.mnemonic: 一段会议、开庭或学期，也叫会话。
session.example: The training session lasted two hours.
session.translation: 培训课程持续了两个小时。

welcome.example: Welcome to our school! We are glad to meet you.
welcome.translation: 欢迎来到我们学校！我们很高兴见到你。

danger.mnemonic: 红灯亮起，前面写着 DANGER，脚下就是悬崖——别往前一步。
danger.example: The sign warns of danger ahead on the mountain road.
danger.translation: 路牌警告前方山路上有危险。

domestic.mnemonic: 家里的沙发、国内的航班、院子里养的狗，都是 domestic 的日常。
domestic.example: She prefers domestic flights to save money and time.
domestic.translation: 为省钱省时，她更愿意乘国内航班。

earth.mnemonic: 脚踩的这颗星球叫地球，手里捏的那把土也是 earth。
earth.example: We must protect the earth for future generations.
earth.translation: 我们必须为后代保护地球。

paris.mnemonic: 埃菲尔铁塔、塞纳河、咖啡馆——想到巴黎就想到这些。
paris.example: They spent their honeymoon in Paris last spring.
paris.translation: 去年春天他们在巴黎度蜜月。

literature.mnemonic: 书架上那排小说诗歌，加上产品广告册，都算 literature。
literature.example: She studies English literature at a famous university.
literature.translation: 她在一所著名大学学习英国文学。

rain.mnemonic: 乌云一压，雨点砸在窗上，出门记得带伞。
rain.example: Heavy rain cancelled the football match yesterday.
rain.translation: 昨天大雨使足球比赛取消了。

desire.mnemonic: 橱窗里那双鞋，你盯着看了很久——这就是 desire。
desire.example: She had a strong desire to travel the world.

assessment.mnemonic: 老师收走试卷打分，医生看片定病情，都是在做评估。
assessment.example: The teacher gave a fair assessment of each student's work.
assessment.translation: 老师对每个学生的作业做了公正的评估。

injury.mnemonic: 球场上被铲倒，膝盖流血，这就是 injury。
injury.example: He missed the game because of a knee injury.

respect.mnemonic: 见到长辈起身问好，认真听人把话说完，就是尊重。
respect.example: We should respect other people's opinions.
respect.translation: 我们应该尊重别人的意见。

paint.mnemonic: 刷子蘸上油漆刷墙，也可以蘸颜料画一幅画。
paint.example: They will paint the kitchen walls light blue.
paint.translation: 他们要把厨房的墙刷成浅蓝色。

northern.mnemonic: 地图上往北走，越走越冷，那里是北方。
northern.example: The northern part of the country is very cold.
northern.translation: 这个国家的北部非常寒冷。

nod.mnemonic: 听人说话时上下点头，表示同意或快睡着打盹。
nod.example: She gave a nod and smiled.

fuel.mnemonic: 往火里添柴给车加油，都是加燃料。
fuel.example: We need fuel for the fire and the car.
fuel.translation: 我们需要燃料来生火和开车。

leaf.mnemonic: 一页纸像树叶，翻书页时叶子沙沙响。
leaf.example: A green leaf fell on my book.

dry.mnemonic: 衣服晒干，嘴唇干裂，说话也枯燥。
dry.example: The clothes will dry in the sun.

russian.mnemonic: 俄国人喝伏特加，说俄语。
russian.example: My friend is Russian and speaks Russian.
russian.translation: 我朋友是俄国人，说俄语。

instruction.mnemonic: 按指令一步步做，也是老师教导。
instruction.example: Follow the instruction on the screen.
instruction.translation: 按照屏幕上的指令操作。

pool.mnemonic: 夏天跳进水塘泳池，公司也联营共享资源。
pool.example: The children swim in the pool.

climb.mnemonic: 手脚并用往上攀登，爬上山坡。
climb.example: They climb the mountain every summer.
climb.translation: 他们每年夏天爬这座山。

sweet.mnemonic: 糖果很甜，情人的话也甜蜜。

engine.mnemonic: 汽车引擎发动，像机车的心脏。
engine.example: The engine makes a loud noise.

fourth.mnemonic: 排第四，蛋糕切四分之一。
fourth.example: This is the fourth time I called you.
fourth.translation: 这是我第四次给你打电话。

salt.mnemonic: 盐让菜变咸，也给谈话添风趣。
salt.example: Please add some salt to the soup.

expand.mnemonic: ex向外+pand铺开：气球一吹气，就向外膨胀撑大
expand.example: Heat makes the metal expand quickly.

importance.mnemonic: 重要的事才值得标红加粗——这就是它的重要性
importance.example: He never understood the importance of sleep.
importance.translation: 他从不明白睡眠的重要性。

metal.mnemonic: 铁锅、铜线、钢钉都是敲起来叮当响的金属
metal.example: This bridge is made of strong metal.
metal.translation: 这座桥是用坚固的金属造的。

fat.mnemonic: 肥肉上那层白花花的油脂就是脂肪；电脑里FAT是文件分配表
fat.example: Too much fat is bad for your heart.

ticket.mnemonic: 进站、看电影前，先在窗口买一张票
ticket.example: I bought two tickets for tonight's show.
ticket.translation: 我买了两张今晚演出的票。

software.mnemonic: 摸不着的程序是软的，看得见的机器是硬的
software.example: Please update the software on your computer.
software.translation: 请更新你电脑上的软件。

disappear.mnemonic: dis不+appear出现：不再出现，自然就消失了
disappear.example: The sun disappeared behind the clouds.

corporate.mnemonic: 穿西装、进高楼、开例会——这是公司社团的日常
corporate.example: She works in a large corporate office.
corporate.translation: 她在一家大型公司办公室工作。

strange.mnemonic: 路上遇见陌生人，他的举动看着有点奇怪
strange.example: A strange man was standing at the door.
strange.translation: 一个陌生的男人站在门口。

reading.mnemonic: 每天半小时读书看报，是很好的阅读习惯
reading.example: Reading before bed helps me relax.

lip.mnemonic: 涂口红的地方就是嘴唇，说话吃饭都靠它
lip.example: She bit her lip and said nothing.
lip.translation: 她咬着嘴唇，什么也没说。

urban.mnemonic: 高楼林立、车水马龙，这是都市的景象
urban.example: Urban life is busy but exciting.
urban.translation: 都市生活忙碌却令人兴奋。

mental.mnemonic: 门里（men-tal）琢磨事，就是心智活动。
mental.example: Mental health is as important as physical health.
mental.translation: 心理健康和身体健康一样重要。

increasingly.mnemonic: crease是折痕，越折越深，逐渐增加。
increasingly.example: It is becoming increasingly difficult to find a quiet place.
increasingly.translation: 找一个安静的地方变得越来越难。

lunch.mnemonic: 中午拎（lun）着饭盒吃（ch）一顿，就是午餐。
lunch.translation: 我们明天一起吃午饭吧。

educational.mnemonic: education加al，把教育变成教育性的。
educational.example: The museum offers many educational programs for children.
educational.translation: 这家博物馆为孩子们提供许多教育项目。

somewhere.example: I left my keys somewhere in the living room.
somewhere.translation: 我把钥匙落在客厅某个地方了。

farmer.mnemonic: farm（农场）+er（人）——在农场干活的人。
farmer.example: The farmer gets up early to milk the cows.

sugar.mnemonic: 谐音“舒格”：咖啡加糖，舒服又甜。
sugar.example: She added a spoonful of sugar to her tea.

planet.example: Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun.
planet.translation: 火星是离太阳第四近的行星。

favorite.mnemonic: 谐音“飞沃瑞特”：飞向最爱的沃土。
favorite.translation: 蓝色是我最喜欢的颜色。

explore.mnemonic: ex（向外）+plore谐音“扑浪”——向外扑浪探险。
explore.example: They set out to explore the unknown forest.
explore.translation: 他们出发去探索那片未知的森林。

obtain.example: You can obtain more information from our website.
obtain.translation: 你可以从我们的网站获得更多信息。

enemy.mnemonic: 谐音“爱呢米”：敌人来了，爱呢？米也没了。
enemy.example: He treated everyone kindly, even his enemy.
enemy.translation: 他对每个人都很友善，甚至对他的敌人。

complex.mnemonic: 一个购物中心综合体很复杂，还藏着情结。
complex.example: The new complex includes a mall and offices.
complex.translation: 新的综合体包括商场和办公室。

surround.mnemonic: 四面围住，像水环绕小岛。

athlete.mnemonic: 运动员在跑道上挥汗如雨。
athlete.example: The athlete won a gold medal.
athlete.translation: 这位运动员赢得了一枚金牌。

invite.mnemonic: 发请柬邀请朋友，也可能招致麻烦。
invite.example: I invite you to my birthday party.
invite.translation: 我邀请你来我的生日派对。

repeat.mnemonic: 重复一遍又一遍，像录音回放。

soul.mnemonic: 灵魂深处藏着一个人的精神。
soul.example: She has a kind and gentle soul.
soul.translation: 她有一个善良温柔的灵魂。

scientific.mnemonic: 科学的方法需要系统验证。
scientific.example: We need a scientific approach to this problem.
scientific.translation: 我们需要科学的方法来解决这个问题。

impossible.mnemonic: 不可能的事，像登天一样难。
impossible.example: It is impossible to finish in one day.
impossible.translation: 一天内完成是不可能的。

panel.mnemonic: 仪表板前，专家小组正在讨论。
panel.translation: 专家小组讨论了气候变化。

meaning.mnemonic: 这个词的含义，意味深长。
meaning.example: What is the meaning of this word?

married.mnemonic: 已婚的夫妻，戒指戴在无名指。
married.example: They have been married for ten years.

instrument.mnemonic: 科学仪器是探索的工具。
instrument.example: The doctor used a special instrument.
instrument.translation: 医生使用了一种特殊仪器。

predict.example: Scientists can predict earthquakes, but not always accurately.
predict.translation: 科学家可以预测地震，但并不总是准确。

weather.mnemonic: 看天气weather决定穿什么，也要经受风雨。
weather.example: The weather is nice today, so let's go for a walk.
weather.translation: 今天天气很好，我们去散步吧。

commitment.example: She made a commitment to help him every day.

emotional.example: She became emotional when she heard the news.
emotional.translation: 她听到这个消息时变得情绪激动。

supreme.example: The Supreme Court is the highest court in the US.
supreme.translation: 最高法院是美国最高级别的法院。

bear.mnemonic: 熊能忍受冬天，也能结出果实。
bear.example: I can't bear the noise anymore.
bear.translation: 我再也忍受不了这噪音了。

pocket.example: He put the key in his pocket.

friday.mnemonic: 星期五Friday，周末前最开心的一天。
friday.example: We will meet on Friday afternoon.

thin.example: The ice is too thin to skate on.

temperature.example: The temperature dropped below zero last night.
temperature.translation: 昨晚温度降到了零度以下。

poll.mnemonic: 民意测验poll，投票选谁当总统。
poll.example: The poll shows most people support the new law.
poll.translation: 民意测验显示大多数人支持新法律。

surprise.example: The surprise party made her very happy.
surprise.translation: 惊喜派对让她非常开心。

proposal.mnemonic: 恋爱中 proposal 既是提议也是求婚，向人提出计划。
proposal.example: He made a proposal to improve the plan.
proposal.translation: 他提出了一项改进计划的建议。

consequence.mnemonic: 种什么因得什么果，consequence 就是后果、结果。
consequence.example: This decision may have a serious consequence.
consequence.translation: 这个决定可能会带来严重后果。

breath.mnemonic: 深吸一口气，breath 是呼吸，也是片刻气息。
breath.example: Take a deep breath before you speak.

sight.mnemonic: 一眼望去，sight 是视力、景观，也是看见。
sight.example: The sunset was a beautiful sight.
sight.translation: 日落是一道美丽的景观。

balance.mnemonic: 天平两端要 balance，平衡也指账户差额。
balance.example: She lost her balance and fell.

adopt.mnemonic: adopt 一份提案是采纳，adopt 一个孩子是收养。
adopt.example: The company adopted a new policy.
adopt.translation: 公司采纳了一项新政策。

minority.mnemonic: 人数少的一方是 minority，少数、少数民族。
minority.example: Only a minority of students voted against it.
minority.translation: 只有少数学生投了反对票。

straight.mnemonic: 一条直路不拐弯，straight 就是直、直接。
straight.example: Draw a straight line from A to B.
straight.translation: 从 A 到 B 画一条直线。

connect.mnemonic: 把两根线连起来，connect 就是连接、联系。
connect.example: Please connect the printer to your computer.
connect.translation: 请把打印机连接到电脑上。

works.mnemonic: 工厂里机器运转，works 可指工程、工厂、作品。
works.example: The steel works employs many local people.
works.translation: 这家钢铁厂雇用了许多当地人。

teaching.mnemonic: teacher 在做 teaching，教学也指学说、教导。
teaching.example: Her teaching has influenced many students.
teaching.translation: 她的教学影响了许多学生。

belong.mnemonic: 东西属于谁，belong 就是属于；也指合适。
belong.example: Do you belong to a club?

aid.mnemonic: 急救箱写AID，一打开就是援助和助手
aid.example: The first aid kit can aid a wounded hiker.
aid.translation: 急救箱能帮助受伤的徒步者。

advice.mnemonic: 朋友递来忠告小纸条，听不听由你
advice.example: She gave me good advice about saving money.
advice.translation: 她给了我关于存钱的好建议。

okay.mnemonic: 点头说OK，表示同意、批准、行
okay.example: Is it okay if I open the window?

organize.mnemonic: 把散乱文件排好顺序，就是组织
organize.example: We need to organize the files before the meeting.
organize.translation: 我们需要在会议前整理文件。
